headers.Opening: Queen's pawn, Mason variation, Steinitz counter-gambit

reviews.reason: A bishop move immobilizes a rook which was about to take the f7-pawn. The king remains boxed in and must recapture once the bishop gives check.
reviews.distinctness: An advanced pawn boxes the king in. The learner distinguishes a tempting pawn capture on h5 from an exchange secured through a bishop pin.
reviews.solutionVi: Bc5 — Tượng từ d4 đến c5, ghim Xe e7 vào Vua f8. Chẳng hạn, sau …Be2, Trắng chơi Bxe7+. Nếu …Kxe7, Trắng đã đổi Tượng lấy Xe.
hintsVi: Quan sát đường chéo đi qua Xe e7 và Vua f8.
Tượng Trắng có thể đến ô nào trên đường chéo đó?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The black rook can escape laterally or take f7 until Bc5 pins it on c5–d6–e7–f8.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 22 roots. Rxh5 only wins temporarily, as ...Rb7+ and ...Kxf7 in its checked line recover material; Bf6 allows ...Rb7+. Rh8+ allows ...Kxf7, and no immediate mating root exists.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 11 replies permit Bxe7+ Kxe7 for the exchange. There is no capture of the bishop after Bc5. After ...Be2, the deeper line retains the exchange gain through c4 Bd3 Rxh5 Kxf7. Against ...Bd5, the direct exchange is secure before optional further trades.
reviewNotes.level: Nine pieces; Bc5 is the sole bounded material-gaining root. The other rook and the advanced f7-pawn constrain the king but need no preparation.
reviewNotes.provenance: Schnaider–Faryma, 1st 3-0, October 2026. The indexed complete game reaches ply 122 after ...Re7 and Bc5 was played.

reviews.reason: The e-file pin makes a pawn capture safe in a balanced opening.
reviews.distinctness: A central pawn captures through a long file pin. The defender can castle to undo the pin, so the newly won pawn can be protected with Nb3.
reviews.solutionVi: dxc5 — Tốt từ d4 bắt tốt ở c5. Tượng đen e7 không thể bắt lại ở c5 vì sẽ mở cột e cho Xe trắng e1 chiếu Vua e8. Nếu Đen nhập thành, Nb3 đưa Mã tới b3 để bảo vệ tốt c5.
hintsVi: Xe trắng e1 và Vua đen e8 nằm trên cùng một cột.
Tượng e7 có thể rời cột e để bắt ở c5 không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: After dxc5 the e7 bishop is the sole apparent defender of c5 and Bxc5 exposes the king. Removing Re1 makes Bxc5 legal and erases the pawn gain. Bxc6 is the only unrelated White capture then, and bxc6 or Bxc6 trades the minor pieces.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: 37 legal roots were compared. Rxe7+ Nxe7 loses the exchange. Bxc6 bxc6 dxc5 takes the pawn only by using the same e7 pin. Qe2 cxd4 loses the d4 pawn and has no immediate payoff. No immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 33 legal immediate replies preserve the gain. No legal captures of the pawn or e1 rook. Castling unpins the bishop but 10.Nb3 protects c5. In a 500k probe after ...Bxc5, Nxc5 wins the bishop. Quiet ...a6 permits preserving the pawn, including after Bxc6 bxc6 Qd4.
reviewNotes.level: One direct capture wins a pawn, with a simple knight defence if Black castles. The rook remains safe.
reviewNotes.provenance: Daurelle–De La Tullaye, Esports World Cup LCQ GpA, 2026. Checksummed TWIC 1657 game replays to exact ply 16 and preceding Be7. dxc5 is the move played.

reviews.reason: Nxe4 wins the central pawn because the pinned knight cannot take back. White starts slightly behind in nominal material and must choose a concrete capture while the black rook can still check.
reviews.distinctness: A knight takes the pawn while a bishop pins the opposing knight. The f6 knight would otherwise capture the moving knight itself. Black’s rook checks contrast with the quiet kingside pin; this is a reserve if another A example repeats the same decision.
reviews.solutionVi: Nxe4 — Mã từ d6 bắt tốt e4. Tượng d4 ghim Mã f6 vào Vua h8, nên Mã Đen không thể bắt lại ở e4. Nếu Đen đi Kg7 để tháo ghim, Trắng có thể bắt Mã bằng Nxf6.
hintsVi: Mã Đen ở f6 đang che đường chéo nào dẫn đến Vua h8?
Xem Mã Trắng ở d6 có thể bắt tốt nào mà Mã f6 đang bảo vệ.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The d4–e5–f6–g7–h8 diagonal makes the pseudo-legal ...Nxe4 illegal. Removing Bd4 from the post-capture board for the counterfactual makes it legal and leaves White down 220 cp relative to its adjusted start, with no retake on e4.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Reviewed 22 roots, including immediate mate and captures. Bxa7 Nxd5 cancels its first gain. Bxf6+ Rxf6 first trades bishop for knight and needs Nxe4 in a later move for a pawn; that uses removal of the same defender and is slower. The quiet Ne8 PV needs e3 and Bxf6+ on the next White turn and does not take the target directly.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 16 replies are non-captures. Kg7 Nxf6 retains both gains, while Rf2+ Nxf2 and Rc1+ Kxc1 answer the forcing rook checks. The a6 line can temporarily give back the knight gain on f6 only while d8=Q immediately restores a larger gain. Neither Nd6–e4 nor the Bd4 pinner is offered to a legal capture.
reviewNotes.level: One non-sacrificial direct capture secures the pawn; Black’s next move cannot recover it.
reviewNotes.provenance: Akobian–Boyer, Titled Tue 21st May Early, 2024, PGN Mentor Akobian archive. Complete legal game and source checksum match ply 80, with ...Kxh8 preceding the played Nxe4.

reviews.reason: The bishop pin makes a direct pawn-for-pawn capture safe while Black’s rook controls e6.
reviews.distinctness: Pawn takes pawn in a bishop pin while a rook guards the pinned pawn, creating a believable alternative on e6.
reviews.solutionVi: gxf5 — Tốt Trắng từ g4 bắt Tốt f5. Tượng b3 ghim Tốt e6 vào Vua f7, nên Đen không thể đáp …exf5. Trắng thắng một Tốt.
hintsVi: Tốt nào của Đen đang bảo vệ f5?
Xem Tượng b3 đang ghim quân nào trên đường chéo đến f7.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The bishop b3 pins e6 to f7; ...exf5 would erase the only immediate gain and there is no White retake on f5.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 31 roots. Rxe6 appears equivalent, but ...Rxe6 Bxe6+ Kxe6 does not preserve the pawn gain. d7 permits ...Re7 and gives no direct gain. The check Bxe6+ loses material after ...Rxe6.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal capture of the moving pawn or stationary bishop after the root. The strong ...Rh8 and ...Rf8 replies allow fxe6+, while ...Rg8+ Kf4 Rb8 Rxe6 preserves and increases the initial gain.
reviewNotes.level: The capture itself wins a pawn; the d6-pawn race is subsequent play. No offer or preparatory move is needed.
reviewNotes.provenance: Sabria Batlle–Yang, Titled Tue 15th Sep 2026. The complete record gives ply 82 after ...gxf5, followed by the played gxf5.

reviews.reason: The diagonal pin wins a pawn immediately and makes the g-pawn advance against counterplay effective.
reviews.distinctness: Black uses a queen to pin a knight across an open diagonal. The pinned knight also stops the opposing rook from recovering the pawn for free.
reviews.solutionVi: fxg5 — Tốt đen từ f6 bắt tốt ở g5. Mã trắng f3 không thể bắt lại ở g5 vì Hậu đen c6 sẽ chiếu Vua g2. Nếu Trắng chơi Rf5, Đen đẩy tốt g4. Sau Rxh5, Đen có gxf3+ và thắng Mã.
hintsVi: Nhìn đường chéo c6–d5–e4–f3–g2.
Quân nào của Trắng đang bảo vệ ô g5?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Q c6 pins N f3 to K g2. Without Q c6, Nxg5 becomes legal after fxg5, erases the pawn gain and Black has no immediate recapture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: 29 legal roots were compared. f5 permits Rxf5, h4 and the queen retreat moves allow gxf6, and Qxf3+ Kxf3 loses the queen for a knight. No mate or competitive simple capture.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 18 legal immediate replies retain the pawn. No legal capture of g5 or c6. ...Rf7+ loses to Kxf7. Supplemental 500k probes confirmed that Rf5 g4 Rxh5 gxf3+ settles at +320 cp material; Rd4 and Rb4 allow g4 with at least the same gain.
reviewNotes.level: Black immediately takes the pawn without an offer. The standard defence requires only advancing the same pawn against the pinned knight.
reviewNotes.provenance: Sjugirov–Aliyev, 2nd 3-0 Thu 4th Jun 2026, checksummed TWIC 1648. Full replay gives exact ply 95 after hxg5. fxg5 was played.

reviews.reason: Rxf6 wins the bishop because its only potential recapturer is pinned. The rook remains safe against counterchecks and the b-pawn race does not recover the bishop.
reviews.distinctness: Two rooks divide the roles in an endgame. The g1 rook restrains the defending pawn and the f1 rook takes the bishop. The direct capture also answers the bishop’s pressure on d4, unlike the packet’s queen pin and e-file bishop pin.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxf6 — Xe từ f1 bắt Tượng ở f6. Xe g1 ghim tốt g7 vào Vua g8, nên Đen không thể đáp ...gxf6. Nếu Đen phản công bằng ...Rxd4+, Trắng đáp Kxd4 và giữ phần vật chất vừa thắng.
hintsVi: Quan sát Xe g1, tốt g7 và Vua g8 trên cột g.
Xe nào có thể bắt Tượng f6 mà tốt g7 không thể bắt lại?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Removing the g1 rook makes ...gxf6 legal, turning +330 cp into −170 cp with no White capture on the next move. The g1 rook is essential to keeping the bishop gain.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 24 legal roots compared. Rf4 is met by ...Kf7, d5 by ...Rxd5+, and Rxg7+ by ...Bxg7. None supplies the bishop gain or a direct competing tactic.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal capture of the moving or pinning rook. All 26 immediate replies retain at least +230 cp. ...Rxd4+ permits Kxd4. On ...Rde7, the deeper line handles ...b1=Q with Rfxb1 and still retains +430 cp from the start. The gain is visible before that later endgame play.
reviewNotes.level: A. One direct, non-sacrificial capture using a pre-existing pin. The gain is visible without calculating the later pawn race.
reviewNotes.provenance: Schmidt–Strehse, Werner-Ott-Open, 2026-08-04. Exact full replay of TWIC 1657 through 41...Bxf6 and 42.Rxf6 at ply 82. FM in the archived Black header. Archive digest and reference retained.

reviews.reason: The queen holds the bishop on the back rank so a pawn can take an advanced opposing pawn without losing its own. The passed pawn and active knight give the defence concrete counterplay.
reviews.distinctness: A pawn takes on a3 far from the pinner, and the pinned bishop controls that square along a different diagonal. The distant pin and removal of an advanced pawn distinguish the decision from two pieces contesting the same square.
reviews.solutionVi: bxa3 — Tốt Trắng từ b2 bắt tốt a3. Hậu c8 ghim Tượng f8 vào Vua g8, nên Tượng Đen không thể bắt lại ở a3.
hintsVi: Nhìn dọc hàng 8 từ Hậu c8 đến Vua g8.
Nếu Tượng f8 rời hàng 8 để bắt ở a3, quân nào sẽ chiếu Vua Đen?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qc8–f8–Kg8 pins the bishop along the rank, disabling ...Bxa3 along f8–e7–d6–c5–b4–a3. Without the pinner that capture is legal, leaves zero net gain and has no immediate White retake.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Reviewed every legal root and forcing alternative. Qxf8+ Kxf8 loses the queen for a bishop and releases the recapture. After f4, ...a2+ Kxa2 gxf4 restores the material balance from the start; ...Ne7 can also leave White trading pawns without retaining a gain.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 15 replies leave the immediate gain. Nc3+ Qxc3 adds a knight. ...Kg7 frees the bishop, but after Ka2, a subsequent ...Bxa3 can be met by Kxa3. After ...g4, the targeted continuation a4 g3 f4 e5 preserves the extra pawn through the tested sequence. No immediate offer of the capturing pawn or Qc8 to a legal capture.
reviewNotes.level: One pawn capture immediately gives a clear material result without preparation or an offer.
reviewNotes.provenance: Anton Guijarro–Gubajdullin, Titled Tue, 2026-09-29, TWIC 1665 checksum and complete game at ply 74. The previous ...bxa3 was en passant, black pawn b4 captured the pawn on a4. White’s played bxa3 is a regular capture.

reviews.reason: White can win a pawn immediately because its rook defender is pinned by the queen.
reviews.distinctness: A queen pins a rook to enable a bishop capture across the board, with the pinned rook otherwise able to recapture horizontally.
reviews.solutionVi: Bxc6 — Tượng từ e4 bắt Tốt c6. Hậu e5 ghim Xe f6 vào Vua g7, nên Đen không thể đáp …Rxc6. Trắng thắng một Tốt.
hintsVi: Xe f6 có vẻ đang bảo vệ Tốt c6.
Nếu Xe rời f6 để bắt lại, quân nào sẽ chiếu Vua g7?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: After Bxc6, ...Rxc6 would expose Kg7 to Qe5. Hypothetical ...Rxc6 would trade a bishop for a pawn with no White retake.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Reviewed all 43 roots. Bd3 may retain positional pressure, but ...Kg8 removes the pin with no immediate gain; Nxb5 axb5 and Bxg6 hxg6 are inadequate. The queen checks on f6/e7 lose material.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Neither the bishop c6 nor queen e5 can be captured after Bxc6. ...Ra7 Ne4 Qc8 Nxf6 exf6 and ...Qb8 Qxe7+ Rf7 both retain at least the c6-pawn gain.
reviewNotes.level: One direct capture with one disabled defender. White starts only 50 cp ahead in material, though it has positional pressure.
reviewNotes.provenance: Ganiev–Gurevich, Titled Tue 1st Sep 2026. The original game reaches ply 42 after ...c6, and Bxc6 was played.

reviews.reason: White is nominally down about a pawn and can take one back because the e6-pawn cannot recapture the queen.
reviews.distinctness: A queen takes a pawn in a crowded center, testing whether a pawn can capture off the pin line even though its destination is otherwise open. Distinct from the sparse endgame pawn captures.
reviews.solutionVi: Qxd5 — Hậu từ d1 bắt tốt d5. Tượng h3 ghim tốt e6 vào Vua c8, nên Đen không thể đáp exd5. Nếu Đen đi Nf6 tấn công Hậu, Trắng có thể giữ tốt đã thắng bằng Qc4.
hintsVi: Tìm đường chéo từ Tượng h3 đến Vua c8.
Xét tốt nào đang bảo vệ d5 và liệu nó có thể rời đường chéo đang che Vua hay không.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bh3 pins Pe6 to Kc8 through g4, f5 and d7. Removing Bh3 in the counterfactual permits ...exd5, wins White’s queen for the pawn, and leaves no White retake at d5.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 33 legal roots compared. Bxe6+ Rxe6 loses a bishop and the later Qxd5 does not recover the deficit. Against e4, ...dxe4 contests the center without giving White the direct gain. No alternative immediate mate or sound independent capture.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: None of the 34 immediate replies captures the queen or the pinner. ...Nf6 is the main attack on Qd5 and Qc4 keeps the pawn. ...Kb8 permits Bxe6 and ...Nd8 is met by Qb5, with later exchanges in the reviewed lines keeping the net gain.
reviewNotes.level: One direct capture, followed by an ordinary queen retreat if attacked. No preparatory moves or sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Kamalsyah–Muzis, Titled Tue, 2026-09-29, TWIC 1665. Complete game replays to ply 24 after ...Re8; Qxd5 Nf6 Qc4 was played.

reviews.reason: The h-file pin lets a rook win a bishop without giving up the exchange.
reviews.distinctness: Two rooks do different jobs. One pins a flank pawn and the other captures across the sixth rank. The king has no legal way to break the pin and win the capturing rook on its next move.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxg6 — Xe trắng từ c6 bắt Tượng ở g6. Tốt đen h7 không thể bắt lại vì rời cột h sẽ để Xe h3 chiếu Vua h8. Nếu Đen dùng Xe bắt tốt ở d4, Hậu trắng bắt lại bằng Qxd4.
hintsVi: Xem Xe h3 đang ghim quân nào trước Vua đen.
Xe c6 có thể bắt Tượng g6 nếu tốt h7 không thể bắt lại.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Without rook h3, hxg6 is legal and costs White the exchange, net -170 cp. No immediate white recapture on g6 exists in the counterfactual. In the game no defender can legally capture either rook immediately after Rxg6.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: 46 legal roots compared. Rxh7+ Bxh7 loses the exchange. Strongest quiet Rc3 Qb4 and Rh1 Rde8 are positional moves, with no short material gain. e4 Qa7 Rxg6 uses the same pin and loses a tempo. No competing immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 38 legal replies keep at least +230 cp immediate material. ...Rc7 has no recovery and the main continuation keeps +330. ...Rxd4 Qxd4, ...Rxe3 Rxe3, and ...Qxe3+ Rxe3 all increase the gain. In the ...Rb8 line, White intentionally trades queen for two rooks later and ends still +330 cp material.
reviewNotes.level: One safe direct capture wins a bishop. There are no forced offers or tactical preparations. Initial +2 pawns give an edge but open lines and Black heavy pieces still provide meaningful counterplay.
reviewNotes.provenance: Razafindratsima–Manukyan, Titled Tue 13th Oct 2026. Checksummed TWIC 1667 replays to exact ply 84 after Qa3. Rxg6 was played.

reviews.reason: Rxf4 converts the bishop pin into a clear pawn gain while removing one of White’s kingside threats. The protected material persists under strong active defence with a non-sacrificial rook retreat.
reviews.distinctness: The pinned defender is a bishop, and the learner takes a pawn while saving an attacked rook. This differs from the packet’s g-file pinned-pawn example, where a rook safely takes a bishop.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxf4 — Xe từ f7 bắt tốt f4 và tránh bị Vua Trắng bắt ở f7. Tượng e5 bị Xe e2 ghim vào Vua e6, nên Trắng không thể đáp Bxf4.
hintsVi: Xe f7 đang bị Vua Trắng tấn công. Tìm một ô có thể bắt quân khi đưa Xe ra khỏi f7.
Hãy kiểm tra đường e2–e6 trước khi xét Tượng e5 có thể bắt lại.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Without the e2 rook, Bxf4 is legal and leaves Black −400 cp relative to the start with no available capture. The stationary rook is the reason the capture works.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 25 roots compared. Rxe5+ allows fxe5, and Rb7 Ra8 takes away a direct material route. Rf6+ itself uses the same e-file pin while White’s Kd5 and Kd7 prevent a next-turn gain. No simpler forcing bypass or positive mate score.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal capture of either Black rook immediately after Rxf4. Rh8+ allows Kxh8. In the strong line g5 hxg5 Kd6, Rfe4 Bc3 g4 keeps the two-pawn increase and both rooks. A separate 1M-node MultiPV probe found the non-sacrificial line alongside an optional exchange-offer PV, which is excluded from the sample.
reviewNotes.level: A. Direct capture without an offer to either involved rook. White’s active king attacks f7, so the initial material edge is contested.
reviewNotes.provenance: Gyenes–Shirov, Titled Tue Late, 2024-08-06. Complete Shirov PGN Mentor archive replay through 37.Ke6 and 37...Rxf4 at ply 73. Credential uses the indexed post-title Shirov archive identity, with archive checksum.

reviews.reason: The threatened rook reverses the attack by pinning and winning the bishop that was attacking it.
reviews.distinctness: The threatened piece itself becomes the pinner and captures a bishop on the next turn.
reviews.solutionVi: Ra6 — Xe từ a5 đến a6, vừa thoát khỏi đòn tấn công của Tượng vừa ghim Tượng b6 vào Vua e6. Ví dụ, nếu …d4, Trắng bắt Tượng bằng Rxb6+.
hintsVi: Tượng b6 đang tấn công Xe a5.
Tìm ô để Xe vừa tránh bị bắt vừa ghim Tượng vào Vua e6.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Ra6 aligns the rook with Bb6 and Ke6. Without the pin the bishop could flee off the sixth rank; it currently attacks the rook on a5.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 12 roots. Rxd5 Kxd5 loses the rook. Ra8 Ke5 and Rb5 Be3 let Black avoid the immediate loss of the bishop. No competing immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Every reply permits Rxb6 with a full bishop gain and no immediate recovery. The pinner has no legal capture against it. ...d4 Rxb6+ secures the bishop while leaving a manageable passer; the engine also demonstrates a longer conversion. After ...Kf6 Rxb6+ Kg5, ...Kxg4 is met by Rxh6 in the tested line.
reviewNotes.level: Eight pieces and one direct move. The a5-rook has to move anyway, which gives the learner a clear starting cue.
reviewNotes.provenance: Stefansson–Preman, Titled Tue 6th Oct 2026. Original game reaches ply 90 after ...Bxb6 and continues with Ra6.

reviews.reason: The bishop creates a clear diagonal pin of a knight in a materially balanced endgame.
reviews.distinctness: A bishop pins a knight guarded by its own king. After the king steps away the bishop can capture, and on ...Ke8 even the White king can collect the knight.
reviews.solutionVi: Bg5 — Tượng trắng từ f4 đến g5, ghim Mã f6 vào Vua e7. Mã không thể nhảy ra khỏi đường chéo để thoát. Chẳng hạn, sau Ke8 (Vua đen về e8), Bxf6 bắt Mã an toàn.
hintsVi: Nhìn hai ô f6 và e7 trên cùng một đường chéo.
Tượng có thể chuyển sang ô nào để tấn công Mã qua đường chéo đó?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bg5 creates the pin along g5–f6–e7, cutting off actual knight escapes such as Nd7 or Ng4. With the same setup but a preliminary b4, ...Kf7 Bg5 Ng4+ illustrates the escape.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 11 legal roots resolve in the local uniqueness proof. d6+ cxd6+ costs a pawn, and b4 Kf7 or Bg3 Ng8 do not force a short gain. No immediate mate or initial capture.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All eight replies allow safe Bxf6 with or without check. Against the strongest ...Ke8 White can also play Kxf6. The complete legal short proof keeps the knight gain through the next Black turn. Neither the bishop nor another solver piece is offered.
reviewNotes.level: 10 pieces, one non-capturing bishop move, one visible knight gain in the explanation.
reviewNotes.provenance: Klimkowski–Grot, Titled Tue 22nd Sep 2026, checksummed TWIC 1664. Full game replays to exact ply 114 after Ke7. Bg5 was played.

reviews.reason: Bb8 is the only root that ensures a visible pawn gain by White’s next move against every legal defence. It creates a real pin on an advancing pawn.
reviews.distinctness: Bishop slides to the board edge to stop both a one-square and a two-square advance. Unlike the rook capture on c2, this is a diagonal pin and uses different geometry depending on whether the king stays on the diagonal.
reviews.solutionVi: Bb8 — Tượng từ a7 đến b8, ghim tốt c7 vào Vua f4. Tốt không thể đi c6 hoặc c5 khi Vua còn trên đường chéo này. Chẳng hạn, sau ...Bd7, Trắng bắt tốt bằng Bxc7+.
hintsVi: Tìm đường chéo đi qua tốt c7 và Vua f4.
Đưa Tượng lên đường chéo đó để tốt c7 không thể tiến.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Before Bb8, ...c6 or ...c5 is available after a neutral move. The b8–f4 pin rules out both advances, leaving the bishop free to collect c7.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 16 legal roots checked. Nd1 ...Bd7, Bc5 ...c6, and Bd4 ...c6 fail to force a short material gain, even though they can maintain a positional advantage. None mates immediately or shows a simpler tactical gain.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 13 legal replies to Bb8 allow a safe Bxc7 or Bxc7+, netting a pawn through the following response. No legal capture of Bb8 after the root. Bg8 and Ke5 can be met by Bxc7+ without a capture reply. Engine alternatives may collect h3 later, which is outside the short motif lesson.
reviewNotes.level: Beginner. Eight pieces, unique one-move decision, no sacrifice, simple pawn escape prohibited. Capture proof is in the explanation.
reviewNotes.provenance: Samdanov–Baturin-Vinogradov, Titled Tue Late, 2026-07-07. Replay of TWIC 1653 through 54...Be6, then 55.Bb8 at ply 108. Both FM in archived headers. Archive reference and checksum retained.

reviews.reason: Nine pieces. Bh4 alone turns a material deficit into a clean rook capture after every defensive reply.
reviews.distinctness: White uses a bishop to trap a more valuable rook along a diagonal immediately after a rook trade. The rook has both file and rank escapes before the pin and is unable to move on the pin line. The initial material deficit makes this a tactical reversal rather than routine conversion.
reviews.solutionVi: Bh4 — Tượng từ g3 đến h4, ghim Xe g5 vào Vua d8. Xe không thể rời đường chéo đang che Vua. Chẳng hạn, nếu Đen đi Kd7, Trắng bắt Xe bằng Bxg5.
hintsVi: Tìm đường chéo đi qua cả Xe g5 và Vua d8.
Tượng Trắng có thể đứng ở đầu đường chéo nào để giữ Xe Đen tại g5?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bh4 places bishop, rook and king on h4–g5–f6–e7–d8. Without the pin the rook can escape e.g. ...Rg4; it cannot move diagonally along the pin. It is captured even if the king unpins.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: The exact short-payoff proof finds one answer from all 20 roots. Bc7+ Kxc7 loses the bishop; quiet moves such as Kf4 Rh5 permit a safe rook escape. No immediate or competing engine mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All nine defensive replies allow Bxg5 or Bxg5+ and keep +500 cp through the immediate opponent reply. King moves cannot defend g5; pawn moves do not interpose or capture the pinner. The engine lines preserve the rook gain after Kc7/Kd7 or ...b6.
reviewNotes.level: One quiet bishop move, with an elementary diagonal pin and a visible capture. Nine pieces and no material offer.
reviewNotes.provenance: Pijpers–Vinke, Ghent Open 2026, TWIC 1654. Complete game at ply 82 after ...Rxg5. Bh4 and later Bxg5+ were played.

reviews.reason: The black bishop cuts off rook escapes from the edge of the board. Only the king approaching c2 can recover the bishop.
reviews.distinctness: An edge-file bishop pins the rook, and the defender must choose whether to approach the capture square via c2.
reviews.solutionVi: Ba4 — Tượng Đen từ b5 đến a4, ghim Xe b3 vào Vua d1. Nếu Trắng chơi Kc2, Đen vẫn có Bxb3+ Kxb3 và đổi được Tượng lấy Xe.
hintsVi: Tìm đường chéo đi qua Xe b3 và Vua d1.
Tượng Đen có thể đứng ở đâu để chặn đường thoát của Xe?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Ba4 pins b3 to Kd1. A rook move off that diagonal would expose the white king.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 24 roots checked. Be2+ Kd2 frees the rook to escape and Re1+ Kxe1 loses a rook. Quiet f5 allows Rh3, without immediate gain.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal capture of Ba4. Each of six replies permits Bxb3 or Bxb3+. ...Kc2 Bxb3+ Kxb3 is the only immediate recapture and leaves the exchange gain; ...Kd2 Bxb3 Kc3 leaves a whole rook in the tested continuation.
reviewNotes.level: Nine pieces and a direct bishop move; distinguish the full rook gain from the exchange if the king recaptures.
reviewNotes.provenance: Sierra Vallina–Nainys, World U17 Open 2026. The full game reaches ply 113 after Ba7 and continues with ...Ba4.

reviews.reason: The bishop ties the rook to the king’s diagonal. Its capture gains a rook or the exchange while preserving the passed h-pawn.
reviews.distinctness: Pinning a rook with a bishop also stops ...Rh5, which would take the passed h-pawn. A nearby king can reduce the win to the exchange. Compare with Be4, where the bishop itself is escaping an attack.
reviews.solutionVi: Bf4 — Tượng từ e3 đến f4, ghim Xe e5 vào Vua c7. Nếu Đen đưa Vua tới d6, Trắng vẫn có Bxe5+ Kxe5, đổi Tượng lấy Xe.
hintsVi: Nếu Xe e5 được đi sang h5, tốt h6 sẽ bị đe dọa.
Tìm đường chéo đi qua Xe e5 và Vua c7.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: After Bf4 the rook cannot leave the f4–c7 diagonal without exposing the king. Before this pin, ...Rh5 is both an escape and a threat to the h-pawn. The root also attacks the rook.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 16 legal roots checked. Bd4 and h7 allow ...Rh5, which stops the short material win, and Bc5 allows ...Rxc5. No other root guarantees a gain over all replies.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All ten replies permit Bxe5 or Bxe5+. On ...Kd6, Bxe5+ Kxe5 still leaves +170 cp gain, rather than the +500 cp of the other branches. No legal capture of the bishop after Bf4. The engine’s h7 in the ...Kd6 line is a stronger endgame continuation but the direct exchange gain does not depend on promotion.
reviewNotes.level: Beginner. Seven pieces, one quiet bishop move, no offer, clear rook escape and visible exchange gain. The live passed pawn explains why restricting the rook matters without being required in the exercise.
reviewNotes.provenance: Kocharin–Potapova, 2nd 3-0 Thu, 2026-09-24. Exact replay of TWIC 1664 through 44...Rxe5, then 45.Bf4 at ply 88. FM and WIM in source. The immediate exchange line is teaching analysis; the game played h7 after ...Kd6.

reviews.reason: Black makes the opposing rook stay put. The nearest white king reply can recover only the bishop.
reviews.distinctness: Black pins a central rook and can concede the bishop to the nearby king while maintaining a pawn majority.
reviews.solutionVi: Bd5 — Tượng Đen từ c4 đến d5, ghim Xe e4 vào Vua g2. Nếu Trắng chơi Kf3, Đen có Bxe4+ Kxe4 và đổi được Tượng lấy Xe.
hintsVi: Quan sát đường chéo nối Xe e4 và Vua g2.
Nếu Vua Trắng tiến đến f3, Đen còn thắng vật chất bằng cách nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bd5 pins Re4 to Kg2. Previously the rook could move away horizontally or vertically. For example, ...Bb3 lets it retreat to e3.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 20 roots. Bf1+ Kxf1 loses the bishop; b5 Kf2 and Bb3 Re3 yield no prompt material gain.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No reply captures Bd5. All nine replies permit Bxe4; Kf3 Bxe4+ Kxe4 still wins the exchange. In the longer Kf3 line the same exchange is retained through the kingside pawn trade.
reviewNotes.level: Ten pieces and a single quiet creating move. The king’s recapture changes the size of the gain but leaves it easy to count.
reviewNotes.provenance: Vazelakis–Ros Eskisabel, Titled Tue 11th Aug 2026. The full game reaches ply 79 after Kxg2 and continues with ...Bd5.

reviews.reason: Qd8 locks the rook to its king on a diagonal, giving a safe rook capture even if the king takes the e4 pawn.
reviews.distinctness: The queen creates the pin while out of the rook’s attack, and the rook cannot move along a diagonal even though a pinned sliding piece sometimes can. The best defence trades an outside pawn for the lost rook.
reviews.solutionVi: Qd8 — Hậu từ c8 đến d8, ghim Xe f6 vào Vua g5. Nếu Đen đáp ...Kf4, Trắng bắt Xe bằng Qxf6+. Sau ...Kxe4, Trắng vẫn thắng Xe đổi một tốt.
hintsVi: Tìm đường chéo đi qua Xe f6 và Vua g5.
Hậu có thể đứng ở đâu trên đường chéo đó mà Xe không thể bắt Hậu?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qd8 attacks f6 along d8–g5, and the rook has no legal move along that diagonal. A quiet king move lets the rook escape instead.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 24 legal roots checked. Qh8 and Qc5 fail to gain a pawn immediately after ...Re6. Targeted 1M-node probes of those lines require several more manoeuvres before any pawn can be collected. Qe8 allows ...Kf4 and a subsequent rook escape. None gives a comparably simple material gain or a forced mate in the recorded search.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: There are five legal replies to Qd8, all king moves, and each permits Qxf6 or Qxf6+. ...Kf4 Qxf6+ Kxe4 yields +400 cp from the start. No legal capture of the queen after the root.
reviewNotes.level: Beginner. Seven pieces, one quiet pin, no offer, and the gain is visible in the next capture. The opponent still has rook and two pawns plus an active king before the tactic.
reviewNotes.provenance: Altini–Hnatyshyn, 2nd 3-0 Thu, 2026-09-03. Exact replay of TWIC 1661 through 60...Rf6 and 61.Qd8 at ply 120. IM and WFM in archived source headers.

reviews.reason: Eight pieces. The fixed pawn structure leaves only king moves after the pin, so the novice can see why the bishop falls.
reviews.distinctness: The neighboring rook and bishop sit on an edge rank segment with the three pawns blocked. This isolates the king move and clean capture rather than teaching a pawn race. Compare the similar Rb5 candidate before final selection.
reviews.solutionVi: Ra4 — Xe từ a3 đến a4, ghim Tượng b4 vào Vua e4. Trắng chỉ có thể di chuyển Vua. Nếu Trắng đi Kd5, Đen bắt Tượng bằng Rxb4.
hintsVi: Tượng b4 và Vua e4 cùng đứng trên hàng nào?
Đặt Xe Đen trên hàng đó để Tượng không thể thoát mà vẫn che Vua.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Ra4 creates the absolute pin across a4–b4–c4–d4–e4. A move such as Bc3 would escape the rook attack if the king were not on that line; the bishop cannot take the adjacent rook.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 21 legal roots checked, with only Ra4 attaining the short material objective. Re3+ Kxe3 loses a rook. The superficially easy Rh3 Be7 Rxh4+ Ke3 Rh1 Bxf6 returns the pawn gain; deeper exploration also finds ...Be1, which delays the first capture.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All five White replies are king moves and admit Rxb4 or Rxb4+. The king cannot retake, and the deeper Kd5 and Kd4 lines preserve the full bishop gain. No legal capture of the rook after Ra4.
reviewNotes.level: Eight pieces, one direct quiet rook move with no offer. Locked pawns keep the payoff visually simple.
reviewNotes.provenance: Angeles Vera–Reprintsev, 2026-06-23, TWIC 1651. The complete game matches ply 145 after Bb4; Ra4 Kd5 Rxb4 was played.

reviews.reason: A file pin takes a bishop while neutralizing meaningful counterplay from advanced Black pawns.
reviews.distinctness: Rook pins a bishop at long range from the back rank. The opponent can push a passed d-pawn to d2 rather than move the king, but the capture of the bishop comes with check.
reviews.solutionVi: Rc8 — Xe trắng từ e8 đến c8, ghim Tượng c7 vào Vua c4. Nếu Đen chơi d2, Rxc7+ vừa bắt Tượng vừa chiếu. Sau Kd5, Vua trắng có thể bắt tốt bằng Kxd2.
hintsVi: Vua c4 và Tượng c7 nằm trên cùng một cột.
Tìm ô trên cột c để Xe vừa tấn công Tượng, vừa chặn đường Tượng chạy.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rc8 creates a c-file pin on c7. The bishop otherwise has escapes with check such as ...Bb6+, or ...Bf4+ after Rh8. It cannot move diagonally with the king behind it.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: 17 legal roots, only Rc8 secures the short gain. Re4+ Kc3 lets the king and bishop retain counterplay. Rh8 Bf4+ only gives a speculative later h-pawn capture, with the advanced d-pawn still active. No immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 10 replies allow Rxc7 with or without check, and no immediate recovery. Passed pawn push ...d2 is met by Rxc7+ Kd5 Kxd2 in the deeper line. ...h5, ...h6 and active king replies do not recover the bishop. No offer of the rook.
reviewNotes.level: 8 pieces and a single rook move. The immediate bishop gain is visible, and the advanced pawn response is met by a straightforward check.
reviewNotes.provenance: Ter Sahakyan–Vershinin, 1st 3-0 Thu 25th Jun 2026. Exact ply 94 after Kc4 from checksummed TWIC 1651. Rc8 was played.

reviews.reason: The backward bishop move wins the exchange while keeping Black’s rook from taking the knight on e5.
reviews.distinctness: A bishop retreats to the back rank to pin a rook that otherwise threatens a knight. The threatened knight remains in place.
reviews.solutionVi: Bd8 — Tượng từ b6 lùi về d8, ghim Xe e7 vào Vua f6. Xe không thể rời đường chéo để bắt Mã e5. Ví dụ, sau …Ke6, Trắng chơi Bxe7 Kxe7 và đổi được Tượng lấy Xe.
hintsVi: Xe e7 đang tấn công Mã e5.
Tìm một nước lùi Tượng để ghim Xe vào Vua f6.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bd8 pins Re7 to Kf6. The legal counterplay before the pin includes ...Rxe5+; a rook retreat off the diagonal after Bd8 would expose Kf6.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 16 roots. Bd4 Kg5 leaves material unchanged; g4 Rxe5+ loses a knight. No initial capture or check yields the objective.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All four replies permit Bxe7, with no capture of the pinner. ...Ke6 Bxe7 Kxe7 and ...h4 Bxe7+ Kxe7 leave the exchange gain. The deeper ...Ke6 line retains it.
reviewNotes.level: Seven pieces, one bishop move, clear improvement over the balanced alternative Bd4.
reviewNotes.provenance: Nakamura–Kramnik, 5th Classic KO 2013. Exact source ply 130 follows ...Kf6 and the game continues with Bd8.

reviews.reason: A rank pin wins the bishop while Black can leave the king in place and push its connected f- and g-pawns.
reviews.distinctness: The rook pins on a rank with two connected Black pawns and an f-file passer. The rook capture checks if Black pushes either pawn, so White takes the bishop with tempo.
reviews.solutionVi: Rb6 — Xe trắng từ b3 đến b6, ghim Tượng d6 vào Vua h6. Nếu Đen đẩy tốt f3, Rxd6+ vừa bắt Tượng vừa chiếu. Nếu Vua đen rời hàng 6, Xe vẫn bắt được Tượng ở d6.
hintsVi: Tượng d6 và Vua h6 nằm trên cùng một hàng.
Xe có thể vào hàng 6 từ cột b để tấn công Tượng.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rb6 pins d6 to h6 along the rank and stops actual escapes such as ...Bc5 after Rd3. The bishop has no capture of the rook or move along the pin.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 14 legal roots compared. Kb1 g4 hxg4 Kg5 Kc2 Kxg4 does not keep the pawn. Rd3 Bc5 lets the bishop leave, and Ra3 or Rb4 hangs the rook. No immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All six legal responses permit safe Rxd6 with or without check, securing +330 cp material. ...Kg7 and ...Kg6 do not recover it, while ...f3 meets Rxd6+ Kh5 Rf6. In the deeper ...Kh5 line White retains the bishop gain long enough to choose a later voluntary rook trade to promote its own b-pawn. The trade is independent of the exercise root.
reviewNotes.level: 8 pieces, one safe pinning rook move, and a visible bishop capture despite passed-pawn counterplay.
reviewNotes.provenance: Shirov–Topalov, Amber Rapidplay 2000, checksummed PGN Mentor game. Exact ply 144 and preceding Bxd6 verified. Rb6 was played.

reviews.reason: Ra2 stops c3 and c4 and leaves a short, safe capture of the c2 pawn against every defence.
reviews.distinctness: Black creates a horizontal rook pin on an advancing pawn from a1. The nearest lookalike is a bishop pin against a pawn, where the line is diagonal. Here White’s knight defends a4, so the correct capture targets the pinned pawn and avoids the tempting rook capture on a4.
reviews.solutionVi: Ra2 — Xe từ a1 đến a2, ghim tốt c2 vào Vua g2 trên hàng hai. Tốt không thể đi c3 hay c4. Ví dụ, sau khi Trắng đi Kf3, Đen bắt tốt bằng Rxc2.
hintsVi: Quan sát tốt c2 và Vua g2 trên hàng hai.
Xe cần tới ô nào để chặn cả c3 lẫn c4 bằng đòn ghim?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: After Ra2, a c-pawn advance would expose Kg2 to the rook along rank two. Without the pin, ...Ra3 for Black lets White advance c4.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 19 roots compared. After Black’s Ra3, White can play c4; after Ne6 White can play d5; neither root guarantees a short gain. Rxa4 is met by Nxa4. No positive mate in the root comparison.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 15 legal replies permit Rxc2 or Rxc2+, keeping +100 cp after the next defensive move. White has no legal capture of the rook after Ra2. Strong active tries Kf3, Kf2 and d5 still leave the pawn vulnerable.
reviewNotes.level: Beginner. Ten pieces, one quiet pin, no offer, and both pawn advances are visibly stopped. The outside pawns provide counterplay but do not force a long proof.
reviewNotes.provenance: Titus–Ten Hertog, 51st OKU, 2026-05-15. TWIC 1645 replay through 37.Nb6 then 37...Ra2 at ply 73, the final recorded move. GM in the Black header. Kf3 Rxc2 is teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: Ten pieces. The rook pins the knight and teams with the bishop to win it rather than trading bishop for knight.
reviews.distinctness: The pinner does more than attack the knight: it protects g3 for the bishop, and the bishop protects g3 for the rook. This creates a contrast between taking first and first pinning a knight next to its king.
reviews.solutionVi: Re3 — Xe từ e1 đến e3, ghim Mã g3 vào Vua h3. Tượng e5 và Xe e3 cùng khống chế g3. Ví dụ, sau Kh4, Đen bắt Mã bằng Rxg3.
hintsVi: Tìm hàng ngang nối Mã g3 với Vua h3.
So sánh việc bắt Mã ngay bằng Tượng với việc đưa thêm Xe tới khống chế ô g3.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Re3 creates a horizontal pin and makes knight escapes such as Nf1 illegal while White’s king remains on h3. The mutual rook and bishop protection on g3 keeps the capturing piece safe from the king.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 26 roots examined, and only Re3 has the exact short gain. Bxg3 Kxg3 trades away the bishop instead of winning the knight and the later Rxa4 only brings the tested line to +90 cp. Rh1+ Nxh1 loses the rook; no shorter mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 11 replies permit a safe g3 capture. Kh4 Rxg3 was played and Be2 Rxg3+ retains the knight gain. Against Bc6 or Ba6, Bxg3 Bxb7 still leaves a net +220 and targeted deeper lines keep the material. No legal immediate capture of the rook or bishop after Re3.
reviewNotes.level: Ten pieces. The one quiet move pins the knight without an offer, and the existing bishop makes the capture visible.
reviewNotes.provenance: Jannur–Devaev, Titled Tue, 2026-10-13, TWIC 1667. Full game matches ply 117 after Ng3; Re3 Kh4 Rxg3 was played.

reviews.reason: A file pin traps a knight that has just captured on f3 and threatens a second pawn.
reviews.distinctness: White places the rook behind a knight on the f-file, stopping the imminent Nxh2 and gaining the knight even if Black advances the h-pawn.
reviews.solutionVi: Rf1 — Xe trắng từ d1 đến f1, ghim Mã f3 vào Vua f6. Mã không thể nhảy sang h2 để bắt tốt. Nếu Đen chơi Ke5 (Vua đen sang e5), Rxf3 bắt Mã.
hintsVi: Tìm cột có cả Mã f3 và Vua f6.
Xe cần đến ô nào để Mã không thể nhảy sang h2?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rf1 creates the pin and stops real escapes from f3, including Nxh2 as in the refutation of Kd6. The pin did not exist after ...Nxf3.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: 21 legal roots compared; only Rf1 achieves the short material objective. Kd6 and Kc4 both permit ...Nxh2. h3 Ke5 Rd3 Kf4 saves h2 without winning anything. No immediate mate or opening capture.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All six legal replies allow Rxf3 with or without check. ...Ke5 allows immediate capture. If Black chooses ...h3 or ...e5 the knight capture is check. No capture of the rook or immediate recovery. Shallow and deeper checks agree on the clear knight gain.
reviewNotes.level: 10 pieces, near-equal material, one quiet rook move with no offer and a direct knight win.
reviewNotes.provenance: Grischuk–Svidler, World Blitz Playoff 2006, checksummed PGN Mentor Svidler archive. Exact ply 104 after Nxf3. Rf1 was played.

reviews.reason: Be4 escapes the rook’s attack while pinning that rook. Every legal reply leaves a rook capture for a bishop or less.
reviews.distinctness: The bishop’s move serves as both an escape and a pin, reversing an existing attack. Bf4 in the same packet stops a rook from hunting a passed pawn; here the object under immediate attack is the pinning bishop.
reviews.solutionVi: Be4 — Tượng từ d3 đến e4, tránh đòn tấn công của Xe và ghim Xe d5 vào Vua b7. Nếu Đen đi ...Kc6, Trắng có Bxd5+ Kxd5 và đổi Tượng lấy Xe.
hintsVi: Xe d5 đang tấn công Tượng d3.
Tìm ô trên đường chéo d5–b7 để Tượng vừa thoát bị bắt vừa ghim Xe.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Be4 changes who attacks whom: the bishop leaves the d-file and ties Rd5 to Kb7. Other bishop retreats allow the rook to leave the attack safely, for instance Bc4 Re5.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 18 roots compared. The rook escapes after c4 Rd4 or h4 Rh5, and h4 also permits ...Bxh4. Be4 is the only short material gain and no mate is recorded from any competing root.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 15 legal replies allow Bxd5 or Bxd5+, with minimum gain +170 cp. ...Kc6 Bxd5+ Kxd5 is the legal recapture and still wins the exchange. No legal capture of Be4 after the first move. The engine also considers the optional preparatory c4 in this branch, but it is unnecessary for the direct gain.
reviewNotes.level: Beginner. Eight pieces and one quiet decision that simultaneously moves the attacked bishop and creates the pin. A potential equal-to-the-goal king recapture still leaves a net exchange gain.
reviewNotes.provenance: Dann–Nepomniachtchi, Titled Tue Early, 2025-08-19. Exact full archived replay through 44...Rxd5 and 45.Be4 at ply 88. PGN Mentor checksum retained and indexed post-title archive credential. The immediate ...Kc6 Bxd5+ line is teaching analysis, while the game played c4 first.

reviews.reason: The rook f6 is under attack after ...Qe7, and its safe capture on h6 relies on the queen’s pin.
reviews.distinctness: The queen pins a pawn from a distance while a rook under attack finds a safe capture, instead of retreating.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxh6 — Xe từ f6 bắt Tốt h6. Hậu g3 ghim Tốt g7 vào Vua g8, nên Đen không thể đáp …gxh6. Trắng vừa đưa Xe khỏi tầm bắt của Hậu e7, vừa thắng một Tốt.
hintsVi: Hậu e7 đang tấn công Xe f6.
Tốt g7 có thể bắt lại trên h6 mà không để lộ Vua g8 không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qg3 pins g7 to Kg8. Without that pin, ...gxh6 would win a rook for a pawn and White has no immediate recapture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 40 roots compared. Rf4 Rf8 does not win material; Rxd6 Qxd6 and Rxa5 Rxa5 lose the rook. Rf8+ Rxf8 and Qxg7+ Kxg7 are not mating shortcuts.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: After Rxh6 no legal reply captures Rh6 or Qg3. ...Rf8 Qg6 Rf4 g3 retains the pawn gain while checking Black’s activity. The deep ...Qe8 Rh3 Qe6 Qh4 Qh6 Qxe4 line increases the gain. Later rook trades are equal exchanges.
reviewNotes.level: One direct capture both saves the rook and gains a pawn. No preliminary move or offer.
reviewNotes.provenance: Ambartsumova–Aarit Kapil, Titled Tue 22nd Sep 2026, exact ply 52 after ...Qe7. Rxh6 is the played move and TWIC 1664 is archived with its checksum.

reviews.reason: The d4 pawn is the only potential recapturer on e5. The diagonal pin turns a same-value rook capture into a material gain, with a separate legal capture on e4 limiting but never erasing it.
reviews.distinctness: A bishop remotely protects an equal-value rook capture by pinning a pawn. The neighbouring bishop can be lost to the other pawn, but ...dxe4 leaves a material gain. This differs from the packet’s g-file rook pin, where the target is a bishop and there is no immediate side capture of a minor piece.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxe5 — Xe từ e8 bắt Xe ở e5. Tượng b6 ghim tốt d4 vào Vua g1, nên Trắng không thể đáp dxe5. Nếu Trắng chọn fxe4, Đen đáp ...dxe4 và vẫn thắng vật chất.
hintsVi: Quan sát đường chéo từ Tượng b6 đến Vua g1.
Tốt d4 có thể bắt lại trên e5 mà vẫn che được đường chiếu vào Vua không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: With the b6 pinner removed, White can answer dxe5, leaving Black zero nominal gain. Black’s Qxh3 allows Bxh3 and Bxf3 allows Rxf3 or Bxf3, so neither immediate capture restores a gain. The real diagonal pin is necessary.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 44 legal starts compared. Bf5, Bg6 and Bh7 allow Rxe8+ Rxe8 with an ordinary exchange, not a quick gain. The forcing Bxd4+ permits Qxd4, and Qxh3 allows Rxe8+ Rxe8 Bxh3. No simpler material gain or mating continuation in the root evidence.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal capture of the moving rook or stationary bishop after Rxe5. All 33 immediate replies retain at least +170 cp. Against fxe4 dxe4, Black keeps +270 cp at the first settlement and +170 cp after the deep exchange sequence. Replayed Qe3, Qe2, Kh2 and both queen captures. In Qe3, temporary recovery after Rxf6 is answered by ...Rxe4 and ...gxf6, restoring +570 cp.
reviewNotes.level: A. One direct non-sacrificial capture from balanced material. The legal fxe4 only wins an already attacked bishop after Black takes the rook. Its immediate recapture leaves the gain clear.
reviewNotes.provenance: Mester–Shevchenko, Titled Tue, 2026-07-21. Full TWIC 1655 game replays to the exact FEN after 25.f3 and 25...Rxe5 at ply 49. Both source player headers show FM and the archive digest is present.

reviews.reason: The rook sets a file pin that stops the bishop escaping. The distant white king cannot reach d3 in time.
reviews.distinctness: A black rook pins down a file, and the distant king cannot approach. The knight can give an interposing check only after the bishop is already lost.
reviews.solutionVi: Rd1 — Xe Đen từ a1 đến d1, ghim Tượng d3 vào Vua d7. Chẳng hạn, nếu Trắng chơi Ke8, Đen bắt Tượng bằng Rxd3.
hintsVi: Tìm cột có cả Tượng d3 và Vua d7.
Xe Đen có thể đứng ở ô nào để ghim Tượng?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rd1 pins Bd3 to Kd7. The bishop has genuine escapes to c2 and e2 before the pin; for example ...Ke3 allows Bc2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 22 roots. ...e4 Bxe4 Kxe4 exchanges bishop for knight and fails to win material. ...Ra7+ Nxa7 loses the rook. No other root gains material in the stated horizon.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal capture of the pinner. All 17 replies permit Rxd3 with at least +330 cp through the next reply. ...Ke8 Rxd3 Kf8 Rb3 and ...Nc3 Rxd3+ Nd5+ Kf5 retain the bishop gain. In the deeper ...Ke7 line both sides may promote, which preserves the gain.
reviewNotes.level: Ten pieces. A single rook move prevents the bishop from escaping. A knight check after the capture does not recover the material.
reviewNotes.provenance: Ibadov–Puzyrevsky, Titled Tue 25th Aug 2026, exact ply 97 after c4. Rd1 was played in the complete TWIC 1660 game.

reviews.reason: Black creates a simple diagonal pin, regaining the exchange or taking the entire rook according to the king reply.
reviews.distinctness: A Black-to-move exchange deficit rescue. The king can step towards the pinned rook and accept an exchange into a four-pawn ending. The example follows that exact game continuation.
reviews.solutionVi: Bf4 — Tượng đen từ e5 đến f4, ghim Xe e3 vào Vua c1. Nếu Trắng đi Kd2, Đen bắt Xe bằng Bxe3+. Sau Kxe3, Đen đã đổi Tượng lấy Xe và gỡ lại phần vật chất bị thiếu.
hintsVi: Xe e3 và Vua c1 nằm trên cùng một đường chéo.
Tượng đen có thể đến ô nào để Xe không thể rời đường chéo đó?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bf4 creates a pin along f4–e3–d2–c1 and stops actual escapes such as Re8, seen after Bf6. The rook could otherwise leave its attacked square safely.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 15 roots compared, only Bf4 secures the short gain. Bf6 Re8 and Bd4 Re8 let the rook leave, while Bb2+ Kxb2 loses the bishop. No immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All five legal replies allow Bxe3. Only Kd2 Bxe3+ Kxe3 can recapture, giving Black +170 cp through an ordinary favorable exchange. The deeper probe after Kd2 also allows White to decline the recapture, in which case Black keeps +500 cp. The four other king replies allow the full rook gain. Neither the solver nor pinning piece is offered at the root.
reviewNotes.level: 8 pieces, only one quiet answer, and a straightforward capture or exchange one turn later. The four-pawn continuation stays in source replay.
reviewNotes.provenance: Sokolov–Ivanchuk, Corus A, Wijk aan Zee 2006, checksummed PGN Mentor Ivanchuk archive. Full replay confirms exact ply 121 after Rxe3. Bf4 and the entire Kd2 Bxe3+ Kxe3 line were played.

reviews.reason: Rb7 creates a real pin on the bishop from balanced starting material. Every legal defence leaves a straightforward safe bishop capture.
reviews.distinctness: A rook comes up the b-file and attacks on rank seven, restraining a bishop that had diagonal escape squares. Black’s knight is active but cannot recapture on d7. Unlike the pawn-pin example Ra2, this wins a minor piece, and a defence with the knight is available.
reviews.solutionVi: Rb7 — Xe từ b3 đến b7, ghim Tượng d7 vào Vua h7. Nếu Đen đưa Vua đến g6, Trắng bắt Tượng bằng Rxd7.
hintsVi: Quan sát Tượng d7 và Vua h7 trên hàng bảy.
Đưa Xe lên hàng đó để Tượng không thể rời đường ghim.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rb7 ties d7 to the king on h7 and cuts off legal escapes including Ba4 and Bc8. Without the pin the bishop can leave on a diagonal. Its knight cannot take the rook on d7.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 21 legal roots checked. e6 allows ...Ba4, ...Be8, or ...Bc8 and yields no direct gain across those replies. Rb8 allows ...Bh3 and Kg5 allows ...Kg7. The e-pawn advance can yield a favorable long pawn ending but gives no equally short gain through these defences.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All eight legal replies yield a safe Rxd7 or Rxd7+, securing +330 cp through the next legal response. No legal capture of b7 after the root. The deeper ...Kg6 and ...Nf5 lines confirm direct Rxd7; on ...Nf7 the engine can choose a stronger pawn continuation, but the immediate bishop capture remains safe and independent of promotion.
reviewNotes.level: Beginner. Seven pieces, quiet rook move, no offer, and a direct capture behind a genuine pin. White starts +50 cp nominally and Black has two mobile minor pieces before the tactic.
reviewNotes.provenance: Shuvalova–Zhu, TechM GCL 2026, 2026-09-05. Exact full TWIC 1661 replay through 69...Nxh6 and 70.Rb7 at ply 138. The game ended there; ...Kg6 Rxd7 is teaching analysis. IM and GM in the archived headers; exact source checksum retained.

reviews.reason: Rh4 alone wins the knight directly. White has an advanced h-pawn, which the rook can stop after collecting the knight.
reviews.distinctness: The rook pins a knight from the far side of its king and wins it without a helper. A passed h-pawn remains a concrete defence that the same rook can stop, unlike the cooperative rook-and-bishop pin in Jannur–Devaev.
reviews.solutionVi: Rh4 — Xe từ h2 đến h4, ghim Mã f4 vào Vua c4. Nếu Trắng đẩy h6, Đen bắt Mã bằng Rxf4+ và Xe vẫn có thể chặn tốt h.
hintsVi: Tìm hàng ngang có cả Mã f4 và Vua c4.
Đưa Xe lên hàng đó để Mã không thể rời đường che Vua.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rh4 puts the rook, knight and king on the fourth rank. Knight moves including Nd5 and Ng6 would escape the rook’s attack, but leave the king in check. The White king cannot reach f4 before Black captures the knight.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 20 legal roots and checked immediate mates. Rxh5 Nxh5 loses the rook. White can play Nd5 or Kd4 after Kc6, or Kb5 after Kd6, without permitting the same short gain. The a4 line needs multiple moves and a pawn offer: Kc5 a3 Nd5+ Kd8 Nxb4 a2 Nxa2 Rxa2 settles only on the fifth Black turn. When White instead takes with bxa4, the best tested Black continuation returns to the pin with Rh4.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All six legal replies permit Rxf4 or Rxf4+. White cannot capture the pinning rook after Rh4. Kb5 Rxf4 Kxa5 can recover only a pawn (+220 cp remains) and the rook stops h6–h7; after Kd4 Rxf4+ Ke3 Rf5 h6 Rh5 h7 Rxh7 the pawn cannot recover the gain.
reviewNotes.level: Eight pieces and one unsacrificed rook move. The immediate pawn push h6 still allows Rxf4+ and an easy demonstration of the payoff.
reviewNotes.provenance: Eynullayev–Bacrot, Titled Tue 27th Jun Early 2023, checksum-bound PGN Mentor Bacrot archive. Game replays to ply 105 after Nf4. Rh4 was played as the final recorded move; Rxf4 lines are analysis.

reviews.reason: Rxd4 removes a passed pawn with a queen pin. Even the king’s immediate unpinning does not recover the pawn.
reviews.distinctness: A queen pins a bishop along a file, allowing a rook to remove a central passed pawn, distinct from the queen’s rank pin in the a3-pawn example.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Rxd4 — Xe từ d1 bắt Tốt thông d4. Hậu f4 ghim Tượng f6 vào Vua f8, nên Đen không thể đáp …Bxd4. Trắng thắng một Tốt.
hintsVi: Tượng f6 có vẻ đang bảo vệ Tốt d4.
Nếu Tượng rời cột f để bắt Xe trên d4, Hậu f4 sẽ tấn công quân nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qf4 pins Bf6 down the f-file. Hypothetical ...Bxd4 removes the rook, so the capture depends on the pin even if the queen later retakes the bishop.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 30 roots compared. Qf3 leaves the passed pawn and wins no prompt material against ...h5. Qxd4 permits ...Bxd4 Rxd4 and loses the queen for bishop and pawn. Qxf6+ Qxf6 and Qxh6 gxh6 lose material. No competing mate score.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal capture of the rook or queen after Rxd4. ...Kg8 Rd6 Qe2 Kg2 preserves the pawn gain. ...Qe2 Re4 and ...Qe5 Qxe5 Bxe5 Rc4 retain the advantage through settlement. The deeper ...Qe8 line wins an additional pawn.
reviewNotes.level: The capture itself wins a pawn. Converting the resulting position with checks and outside pawns comes later.
reviewNotes.provenance: Megaranto–Avirat Chauhan, Quang Ninh Masters 2026. Exact source ply 82 after ...Qe6. White played Qf3, so Rxd4 is labeled analysis. Full game and checksummed archive retained.

reviews.reason: A direct bishop capture wins one of two mutually defending knights because the other knight is pinned.
reviews.distinctness: Black exploits a vertical rook pin to break mutual knight defence. The pinned knight does not guard a pawn or a different piece. White can attack the stationary rook with Bb6, and sliding to d6 along the pin holds the piece gain.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Bxf6 — Tượng đen từ g7 bắt Mã ở f6. Mã trắng d5 không thể bắt lại vì sẽ mở cột d cho Xe đen d8 chiếu Vua d2. Nếu Trắng đi Bb6 tấn công Xe, Rd6 giữ đòn ghim.
hintsVi: Hai Mã trắng ở d5 và f6 đang bảo vệ nhau.
Nhìn cột d từ Xe đen d8 đến Vua trắng d2.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The rook pins d5 to the white king. Without Rd8, Nxf6 is legal, turns the gain into an approximately equal minor-piece exchange (-10 cp), and Black has no immediate recapture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 15 roots compared. Rxd5+ Nxd5 loses the exchange, Rc8 Kd3 Bxf6 Nxf6 releases the pin, and quiet h4 Bd4 makes no gain. No competing material capture or immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 19 replies leave the knight gain intact, with no immediate capture of either Bf6 or Rd8. Against Kd3 Kg7 and Bb6 Rd6, supplementary 600k probes retain the +320 cp gain through the stronger replies. In the longer Kd3 line, White temporarily captures the rook after Bxb4, but Bxd6 settles with the net gain still at +240 cp. Trading bishop for bishop on d4 leaves the original gain intact.
reviewNotes.level: One immediate knight capture, no offer and no preparatory sequence. Black starts down 140 cp and materially improves despite the active White pieces.
reviewNotes.provenance: Smietanska–Janaszak, Titled Tue 9th Jun 2026. Checksummed TWIC 1649 replays to exact ply 79 and preceding Kd2. The game continued Rd6. Bxf6 is a separate teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: The bishop on f1 cannot take on c4 because the queen pins it along rank one. Taking c4 secures a pawn and gives Black a direct answer in a position with active White knights and a passed e-pawn.
reviews.distinctness: An absolute horizontal queen pin prevents a diagonal bishop recapture that would otherwise give check. The learner plays a bishop capture of a pawn while the opposing passed pawn remains a real defensive threat. The other queen pin in this packet is diagonal and restrains a pawn.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Bxc4 — Tượng từ f7 bắt tốt ở c4. Hậu a1 ghim Tượng f1 vào Vua g1, nên Tượng Trắng không thể bắt lại trên c4.
hintsVi: Quan sát Hậu a1, Tượng f1 và Vua g1 trên hàng một.
Nếu Tượng f1 rời hàng một để bắt lại, Vua Trắng sẽ ra sao?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Removing the a1 queen makes Bxc4+ by White legal, changes the material delta from +100 to −230 cp and leaves Black without an immediate capture. The queen pin specifically prevents the recapture of the c4 bishop.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 28 legal roots compared. h6 and Rf8 allow White e6, Be6 allows Nxe6, and Qxf1+ allows Kxf1. The game’s c5 allows e6 as well. None gives a direct alternative gain or a mating shortcut in the recorded evidence.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Neither the bishop c4 nor queen a1 can be captured immediately. All 35 legal replies preserve +100 cp at the first response. Strong Nce2 Rf8 Qd4 Qxd4+ Nxd4 Bxf1 retains +430 cp. Supplementary bounded 500k-node forced-reply probes and material replays for e6, Qd4, Nfe2, Ncd5 and Kh2 found no recovery of the pawn after settlement. For example e6 Qxf1+ Kh2 Bxe6 takes away the passed pawn and raises the gain.
reviewNotes.level: A. One direct capture, no offer by either Black piece, and a clear nominal pawn gain even though Black started behind by 240 cp. The later defensive options need no calculation to see why the capture is safe.
reviewNotes.provenance: Oro–Keinanen, 2nd 3-0 Thu, 2026-06-11. Both IM in the archived TWIC 1649 headers. Full game replays to the exact FEN after 48.Qe3 at source ply 95 with archive digest. The game played 48...c5. Bxc4 is explicitly identified as teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: The fixed pin permits the only safe immediate capture and removes one of Black’s connected advanced pawns while its rook and king still have active defensive resources.
reviews.distinctness: One white rook pins a pawn on the g-file while the other captures across the h-file. The defensive king can unpin g5 and revive an attack on the same rook, so it must move to safety afterward. The position is a reserve if more competitive sources fill A.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Rxh4 — Xe từ h8 bắt tốt h4. Xe g2 ghim tốt g5 vào Vua g6, nên Đen không thể bắt lại ở h4. Nếu Đen đi Kf6 để tháo ghim, Trắng có thể đưa Xe khỏi h4 bằng Rh6+.
hintsVi: Xe g2, tốt g5 và Vua g6 cùng đứng trên cột nào?
Kiểm tra tốt g5 có thể bắt chéo sang h4 mà vẫn che được Vua hay không.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: After Rh8xh4, the g5-pawn cannot play ...gxh4 because Rg2 would check Kg6. Removing Rg2 for the geometric counterfactual makes that recapture legal, producing a net loss of 400 cp from the adjusted start, with no retake at h4.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 24 legal roots reviewed and none is immediate mate. Rxg5+ Kxg5 loses the rook. The strongest quiet alternatives (Kh1, Kg1, Rd8) preserve an existing edge but do not achieve a one-move material gain. The active black rook and connected passed pawns remain a practical contest; Rxh4 makes the immediate concrete difference.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 17 legal replies preserve the capture immediately and none takes either rook. ...Kf6 releases ...gxh4 for a later turn, but Rh6+ Kf5 Rf2+ retains the pawn. ...Kg7 stays on the g-file and ...g4 is met by Rgxg4+. The deepest rook activation lines such as ...Rd5 and ...Rf5 preserve the gain.
reviewNotes.level: One direct capture without an offer. Any later attack on Rh4 after the king unpins can be met by a simple rook move.
reviewNotes.provenance: Tsvetkov–Dreev, Titled Tuesday 2nd June 2020, complete PGN Mentor Dreev archive game. Exact ply 136 after ...Kg6, with a checksum-bound source. The game played Ra8; Rxh4 and its defences are analysis.

reviews.reason: Black turns an equal-material position into a pawn gain by using the second rook to pin the pawn that would recapture.
reviews.distinctness: An open f-file pins a central pawn against a king on its second rank. One rook captures a pawn and the other holds the pin from a distance.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Rxg4 — Xe Đen từ f4 bắt Tốt g4. Xe f8 ghim Tốt f3 vào Vua f2, nên Trắng không thể đáp fxg4. Đen thắng một Tốt.
hintsVi: Tốt f3 đang bảo vệ Tốt g4.
Nhìn dọc cột f để xem Tốt f3 có thể bắt lại trên g4 hay không.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rf8 pins f3 to Kf2. Hypothetical fxg4 wins a rook for a pawn and Black cannot recapture on g4, so the pin is essential.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 27 roots. Ra4 and the played Bb5 leave material even. Rxf3+ Rxf3 Rxf3+ Kxf3 loses a rook for a pawn. The quiet alternatives retain approximate equality.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal capture of either rook after Rxg4. The strongest Rf1 is met by ...Ra4 Kg3 ...Bb5 and Black keeps the pawn. Bd3 ...Be8 Bf1 ...Rh4 and Rg1 ...Rxg1 Kxg1 ...Rf4 show material retention after activity or equal exchange.
reviewNotes.level: One direct pawn capture with a clear illegal recapture. Neither rook is offered and subsequent rook manoeuvres do not create the gain.
reviewNotes.provenance: Rosen–Mendonca, 1st 3-0 Thu 28th May 2026. Exact source ply 63 after Kf2. Black played Bb5, so Rxg4 is labeled analysis. Full game and checksum retained.

reviews.reason: An existing rank pin makes the bishop capture a pawn safely in an otherwise balanced rook-and-bishop ending.
reviews.distinctness: The stationary rook pins a pawn horizontally while the bishop attacks the adjacent file. The capture immediately doubles the pressure on the pinned pawn, so several king moves allow the rook to take it as well.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Bxc4 — Tượng đen từ e6 bắt tốt ở c4. Tốt trắng d3 không thể bắt lại vì sẽ để Xe b3 chiếu Vua e3. Nếu Trắng đi Kf2, Đen có thể bắt thêm tốt bằng Rxd3.
hintsVi: Quan sát hàng 3 từ Xe đen b3 đến Vua trắng e3.
Tượng đen có thể bắt tốt nào khi tốt d3 đang bị ghim?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The b3 rook pins the d3 pawn to the king on e3. Removing Rb3 makes dxc4 legal and Black loses a bishop for one pawn (-230 cp) with no immediate recapture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 23 roots compared. Rxd3+ Kxd3 costs the rook for a pawn, Bxh3 Bxh3 costs the bishop for a pawn, and f5 Kd2 and g4 hxg4 do not yield comparable material. No immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 20 legal replies retain the pawn immediately and none captures Bc4 or Rb3. The only check Bd5+ permits Bxd5. Strong Rd2 f5 h4 Kf6 hxg5+ Kxg5 trades pawns and restores the +100 cp margin at once, then the line retains a material gain. Be4 is met by Kg7 or Be6, both holding the pawn advantage in supplementary 600k probes. Kf2 allows Rxd3.
reviewNotes.level: One direct capture in a balanced position, without a sacrifice. The active bishop and rook then retain the pawn lead through routine exchanges.
reviewNotes.provenance: Sliwicki–Olhovik, 1st 3-0 Thu 6th Aug 2026, checksummed TWIC 1657. Full replay confirms exact ply 67 after Ke3. Bf5 was played in the game. Bxc4 is an independent teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: The queen on d4 prevents the f2 pawn recapturing the rook, so Black can win the bishop from essentially balanced starting material. Forcing queen checks recover at most a pawn in the relevant lines.
reviews.distinctness: A diagonal queen pin on a pawn restrains an immediate rook recapture. White’s defence is a queen-check sequence or a queen trade instead of an adjacent king recapture. Different from the horizontal queen pin and bishop target restriction in Bxc4.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Rxg3 — Xe từ d3 bắt Tượng ở g3. Hậu d4 ghim tốt f2 vào Vua g1, nên Trắng không thể đáp fxg3. Nếu Trắng chiếu Qe8+, Đen đi ...Kh7 và vẫn giữ phần vật chất vừa thắng.
hintsVi: Tìm đường chéo đi qua Hậu d4, tốt f2 và Vua g1.
Kiểm tra xem tốt f2 có thể bắt lại trên g3 hay không.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Without the d4 queen, fxg3 is legal, changes +330 cp into −170 cp and leaves Black with no immediate capture. The stationary queen makes the bishop gain possible.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 41 legal starts compared. Kh7 allows Kh1 with no forced gain, Qd7 allows Qxd7 Rxd7 as an even queen exchange, and the played Rd1 allows Qe8+ or Rxd1 with a trade. Forcing Qxf2+ allows Bxf2. No simpler tactical material gain or positive mating score appears in the compared starts.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Neither g3 nor d4 can be captured legally immediately. All 28 initial replies preserve at least +230 cp. Qe8+ Kh7 Qxf7 gives White one pawn only and the strong replay reaches +330 after ...Qxh3. Qc8+ and Qa8+ are also met by ...Kh7. In the Qa8+ branch ...Rd3 permits an ordinary queen trade via Qxd4 Rxd4 while retaining +330 cp. In the stronger rook activity branch Rc1 Rd3, Black retains the bishop gain after exchanging queens.
reviewNotes.level: A. One direct, safe rook capture using an existing diagonal pin. The starting material difference is only 10 cp and no offer of either participating piece is needed.
reviewNotes.provenance: Drygalov–Darvishi, Titled Tue, 2026-06-30. GM White and CM Black in the archived TWIC 1652 headers. Complete game replays to the exact FEN after 35.Qxc6 at ply 69 with archive digest. The game played 35...Rd1, and Rxg3 is labeled teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: One bishop move creates a real absolute pin and wins at least the exchange against every reply. The stronger black bishop and king recaptures leave a clear material benefit.
reviews.distinctness: The bishop pins a more valuable rook, which Black can sometimes recapture with its king or bishop after Bxc6. The learner wins the exchange even in those defences, unlike the clean rook capture in Pijpers–Vinke.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Bb7 — Tượng từ a6 đến b7, ghim Xe c6 vào Vua d5. Nếu Đen đi Bd7, Trắng có thể bắt Xe bằng Bxc6+; kể cả khi Đen bắt lại Tượng, Trắng vẫn đổi Tượng lấy Xe.
hintsVi: Tìm đường chéo đi qua Xe c6 và Vua d5.
Đưa Tượng tới đầu đường chéo. Sau đó, hãy so sánh giá trị của Xe và Tượng nếu Đen bắt lại.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bb7 creates the absolute b7–c6–d5 pin. If the king were off that diagonal, Rc6 could escape to c7 or h6. Every reply allows the bishop to collect the rook, which has no legal motion along the pin line.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Only Bb7 passes the exact short material test across all 27 legal roots. b5 Re6 lets the rook escape, and Rd8+ Ke5 merely moves the king without immediately winning material. Bc4+ Rxc4 or Re5+ Kxe5 concedes material. No immediate mate or stronger comparable shortcut.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Every one of 15 replies permits Bxc6 or Bxc6+. No immediate capture of Bb7 or Re8 after the root. Independent 800k-node target checks after all 15 direct captures confirmed strong counterplay can be met. Bd7 Bxc6+ Bxc6 Rd8+ keeps the exchange; f3 Bxc6+ Kxc6 Rf8 puts the rook behind the passer. If the king takes on c6, the net gain is at least 170 cp immediately.
reviewNotes.level: Nine pieces, one quiet pin-creating move. The recapture leaves an immediate favorable exchange, so no sacrifice or long sequence is needed to demonstrate the gain.
reviewNotes.provenance: Samunenkov–Tahmasebi, 1st 3-0 Thu 15th Oct 2026, checksum-bound TWIC 1667. Exact full-game ply 128 after ...Kd5. The game played Rd8+; the Bb7 line is analysis.

reviews.reason: The black knight takes a central pawn because the white bishop cannot leave the g-file.
reviews.distinctness: The queen holds a bishop on a long open file so the knight can capture diagonally across the center, unlike the queen–bishop cases with a rook or pawn as capturer.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Nxd5 — Mã Đen từ e7 bắt Tốt d5. Hậu g7 ghim Tượng g2 vào Vua g1, nên Trắng không thể đáp Bxd5. Đen thắng một Tốt.
hintsVi: Tượng g2 có vẻ đang bảo vệ Tốt d5.
Nếu Tượng rời cột g để bắt Mã, Hậu g7 sẽ chiếu Vua g1.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qg7 pins Bg2 to Kg1. Without the queen’s pin, Bxd5 is legal, wins a knight for a pawn and has no Black retake.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 27 roots compared. The played Ng6 followed by Kh2 keeps a positional advantage without an immediate material gain. Qxg2+ Kxg2 and Qxc3 Qxc3+ lose material. No mating shortcut appears in the all-root comparison.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal reply captures the knight d5 or queen g7 immediately. Kf1 Nxc3 Bxb7 leaves a pawn gain, and Kh2 Qf7 c4 Ndf6 keeps d5 safe while retaining the gain. After c4 Qd4+ Qf2 Ne3 Bxb7, ...Nxc2 immediately restores the pawn margin before the equal queen trade.
reviewNotes.level: A single knight capture wins a pawn. Queen and knight coordination for conversion comes later, with no sacrifice required.
reviewNotes.provenance: Amburgy–Weetik, Titled Tue 20th Oct 2026. The exact full game reaches ply 53 after Qe1, then played ...Ng6. ...Nxd5 is analysis, linked to the checksummed archive.

reviews.reason: Choosing the correct rook keeps the pin on the defending pawn, allowing White to take a rook.
reviews.distinctness: Two rooks can take the same rook, but only the f-file rook can move while preserving the pin. This provides an explicit choice between the pinner and the capturing piece.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Rfxe2 — Xe từ f2 bắt Xe e2. Xe d2 tiếp tục ghim Tốt d3 vào Vua d5, nên Đen không thể đáp …dxe2. Nếu dùng Xe d2 để bắt, Trắng sẽ tháo ghim và Đen có thể bắt lại.
hintsVi: Cả hai Xe Trắng đều có thể bắt Xe e2.
Xe nào cần ở lại cột d để Tốt d3 không thể bắt lại?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rd2 pins d3 to Kd5. Without that pin, ...dxe2 trades off the captured rook’s counterpart immediately and no White piece can recapture on e2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 28 roots. Rdxe2 breaks the pin and allows ...dxe2 Rxe2 Bxe2. Rxd3+ Bxd3 loses the rook for a pawn. The played hxg5 allows ...R2xe5 and loses the gain.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No capture of Re2 or Rd2 after the root. ...Rxe5 is met by Rxe5+, and the strongest ...gxf4+ Kxf4 Rf7+ Kg3 leaves the rook gain before normal subsequent recovery trades. ...gxh4+ Kxh4 restores the pawn and retains the rook.
reviewNotes.level: One direct capture. The decision between the two rooks depends solely on keeping the d-file pin, with no sacrifice or preparation.
reviewNotes.provenance: Alcazar Jimenez–Lopez Martinez, TCh-ESP Rapid 2026. Exact ply 108 follows ...g5. The full game has hxg5, so Rfxe2 is labeled analysis.

reviews.reason: The pin of the e4 pawn enables a direct bishop capture that wins a knight. The apparent safer king capture is met by Nxc7.
reviews.distinctness: A rook pins a central pawn to an advanced king on the same file while the bishop captures a knight diagonally. The obvious alternative is a king capture, which gives the opponent time to exchange c-pawns.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Bxd5 — Tượng đen từ e6 bắt Mã ở d5. Tốt trắng e4 không thể bắt lại vì sẽ mở cột e cho Xe đen e2 chiếu Vua e5. Nếu Đen bắt tốt bằng Kxc5 ngay, Mã trắng có thể bắt lại một tốt bằng Nxc7.
hintsVi: Tốt e4 đang bảo vệ Mã trắng d5.
Theo cột e từ Xe đen e2 đến Vua trắng e5. Tốt e4 có thể rời cột này không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Re2 pins e4 to the white king e5. Removing Re2 makes exd5+ legal and the knight gain becomes a slightly unfavorable exchange (-10 cp). Black can play Kxc5 in the counterfactual, but this is only an ordinary pawn capture and does not retain the knight gain.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 22 roots compared. Rxe4+ Kxe4 Bxd5+ leaves Black down material from the start. Kxc5 is met immediately by Nxc7, restoring the pre-exercise balance, and the targeted million-node line Nxc7 Bf5 Kf6 Rxe4 Kxf7 confirms immediate reciprocal pawn captures. Ne7 also produces a roughly equal position, with Rxf7 eventually restoring material parity in a deep line. No immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 11 legal replies leave the +320 cp gain on the next ply. None captures Bd5 or Re2. Against the only strongest reply f5, a supplemental million-node probe gives Kxc5 fxg6 fxg6 Kf6 Bxe4, settling with +520 cp and no piece recovery. Black can also respond gxf5 Kxf5 Bc4 and retain the +320 cp gain after the pawn exchange.
reviewNotes.level: One direct bishop capture, no offer or preparatory move, with no comparable simpler capture and nearly balanced starting material.
reviewNotes.provenance: Rasulov–Dirikolu, Caissa Hotel Drum 2026. Full checksummed TWIC 1646 game replay gives exact ply 79 after Rh4. The game continued Kxc5, and Bxd5 is separate teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: Rxe3 takes the pawn while rescuing the rook attacked by Nd4. The stationary a2 rook stops the f2 pawn from recapturing. Strong checks and pressure against f7 leave a short, sound way to maintain the gain.
reviews.distinctness: The move solves two problems in one action: the b3 rook must leave a knight attack, and it can take a central pawn because the other rook pins f2 horizontally. The earlier g-file two-rook example Rxf6 uses a file pin to win a bishop, with no knight attack on the moving rook.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Rxe3 — Xe từ b3 bắt tốt ở e3 và thoát khỏi đòn tấn công của Mã d4. Xe a2 ghim tốt f2 vào Vua g2, nên Trắng không thể đáp fxe3.
hintsVi: Mã d4 đang tấn công Xe b3. Tìm một nước bắt quân để đưa Xe ra khỏi b3.
Quan sát Xe a2, tốt f2 và Vua g2 trên hàng hai.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: With the a2 rook removed, fxe3 is legal and Black’s material delta changes from +100 to −400 cp with no immediate capture. The blocked recapture is necessary to both win the pawn and keep the rook.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 24 roots compared. Rxf2+ allows Kxf2. The game’s Rbb2 allows Kg3 Rxf2 Kxg4, reducing the material increment to zero. A supplemental 1M-node comparison after Rbb2 Kg3 found no competing immediate gain through Rb1, Ra1 or Rd2. Rb1 as a first move allows Rf6. No immediate or verified positive mate in the reviewed roots.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 23 legal replies retain +100 cp immediately and none captures either rook. Rh6+ permits Kg8 and the replay Rh5 Re5 a5 Kg7 preserves material before Black wins the a-pawn. The strongest Rf6 attacks f7. In a separate 1M-node MultiPV probe, ...Kg7 Rd6 ...Re5 Rd7 ...Rxa4 retained +200 cp from the starting position without any offer. The alternative ...g3 line permits temporary recovery but is not needed.
reviewNotes.level: A. A single safe capture using an existing pin and answering a threat to the rook. The nominal initial edge of 180 cp is contested by the knight attack, an active White rook, and the a-pawn.
reviewNotes.provenance: Luba–Stickler, Titled Tue, 2026-09-08. CM White and FM Black in the archived TWIC 1662 headers. Full game replays to the exact FEN after 38.Nd4 at source ply 75 with archive checksum. The game continued 38...Rbb2. Rxe3 is clearly labeled as teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: A threatened bishop makes the only move that traps the rook. The white king is on the edge and cannot reach d6 to recapture.
reviews.distinctness: The exchange just played leaves the rook attacking the bishop. Black uses the long diagonal to the edge-file king, and the learner can contrast the pin with both an ordinary bishop retreat and a king move that allows the bishop to be captured.
reviews.solutionVi: Be7 — Tượng Đen từ f6 đến e7, vừa tránh bị bắt vừa ghim Xe d6 vào Vua a3. Nếu Trắng chơi Kb3, Đen bắt Xe bằng Bxd6.
hintsVi: Xe d6 đang tấn công Tượng f6.
Tìm một ô trên đường chéo nối Xe d6 với Vua a3.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Be7 stops off-diagonal rook escapes, including Rd2 as demonstrated against Bh4. The rook cannot move along this diagonal and the king cannot reach d6 in one move.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 17 legal roots. Bh4 allows Rd2, while Kg6 allows Rxf6+ Kxf6, conceding the bishop. Bb2+ Kxb2 loses the bishop. No other root wins material in the short horizon.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: None of the five legal replies captures the pinner. Kb3, Kb2 and Ka2 allow Bxd6; f3 and f4 allow Bxd6+. The full rook gain survives every immediate answer and the stronger Kb3 Bxd6 Kc4 continuation.
reviewNotes.level: Seven pieces, a quiet bishop move and a clear rook capture. It reverses a material deficit and requires no offer or preparation.
reviewNotes.provenance: Giordani–Rosen, Titled Tue 29th Sep 2026. The checksummed TWIC 1665 source reaches ply 107 after Rxd6, and ...Be7 was played in the drawn game.

reviews.reason: Rxb4 wins the knight that is attacking the stationary rook. The pin stops an immediate recapture. White’s strongest defence then changes the geometry, but Black can exchange rooks and keep a knight-for-pawn gain.
reviews.distinctness: The target knight attacks the pinner and the c6 rook performs two roles. It first holds the pawn to the king, then Black can move it to a6 to exchange rooks. This lets the same pawn take on b4 later, after the knight gain is secured. Published Rxf6 and Rxe3 use similar rook cooperation without this visible release of the pin and legal delayed recapture.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxb4 — Xe từ c4 bắt Mã ở b4. Xe c6 ghim tốt c3 vào Vua c2, nên Trắng chưa thể đáp cxb4. Trong ván đấu, Trắng đi Rxa6. Đen đáp ...Rxa6 và lúc đó tốt c3 mới bắt được Xe trên b4. Qua chuỗi đổi này, Đen thắng một Mã và mất một tốt.
hintsVi: Mã b4 đang tấn công Xe c6. Hãy xem Xe c4 có thể bắt Mã không.
Kiểm tra cột c trước khi xét tốt c3 có thể bắt lại trên b4 hay không.
