reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Removing the c6 rook makes cxb4 legal, turning the knight gain of +320 cp into −180 cp. Bxf4 in that counterfactual only reaches −80 cp and allows Rxa6 or Nxf4. The c-file pin is necessary to retain a material gain.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 28 legal roots compared. Rc8 allows Nd3, Rd6 allows f3 followed by pressure on a6, and Rxc3+ allows Rxc3 Rxc3+ Nxc3. No simpler independent capture or positive mating score was found.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Neither involved rook can be captured immediately after Rxb4. All 25 legal first replies retain at least +220 cp. The actual Rxa6 Rxa6 cxb4 trades one rook each and retains +220 cp. Separate 1.5M-node MultiPV spot checks found non-sacrificial ...Rc5 after Rxa6, ...Bxf4 after Rea1 and ...gxf5 after f5 with the material gains maintained. The optional rook offer ...Rb2+ after Rxa6 is unnecessary.
reviewNotes.level: A. Direct capture of a threatening knight, no offer, and the first reply cannot recapture. The short, ordinary rook exchange in the game demonstrates why a later recapture does not undo the gain.
reviewNotes.provenance: Admiraal–Ernst, 27th Olomouc A GM, 2026-08-16. Full TWIC 1659 replay gives the exact FEN after 39.Nxb4 at ply 77, with the played 39...Rxb4 and the follow-up rook exchange. IM and GM in archive headers, checksum retained.

reviews.reason: Bd3 is the only move that pins the rook and gives White at least the exchange through both king recaptures.
reviews.distinctness: Black has only a king and a rook. The pin stops Rxh2, and Black can either accept a favorable exchange for White from two distinct king squares or collect the h2 pawn after losing the rook. The quiet alternative h4 only defends the pawn, leaving the rook active.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Bd3 — Tượng trắng từ f5 đến d3, ghim Xe e2 vào Vua f1. Nếu Đen đi Kf2 hoặc Ke1, Trắng bắt Xe bằng Bxe2. Sau Kxe2, Trắng vẫn lời vì đổi Tượng lấy Xe.
hintsVi: Xe đen e2 đang dọa bắt tốt h2.
Tìm đường chéo đi qua Xe e2 và Vua f1.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bd3 creates a new pin along d3–e2–f1. The rook would otherwise escape or take h2, as shown after Kf7 Rxh2. No legal rook move survives the pin.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 19 legal roots resolved. Bh3+ Ke1 fails to win material. h4 Rh2 keeps the h-pawn for now but gives the rook time to attack the queenside, while h3 Ra2 and a4 Ra2 also permit material recovery. No immediate mate or starting capture.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All four replies allow Bxe2. Kf2 and Ke1 permit immediate Kxe2, retaining +170 cp. From Kg1 or Kg2 the only immediate capture is Kxh2, leaving +400 cp. There is no legal capture of the bishop before the payoff. The strongest Kf2 line retains the exchange gain through the subsequent pawn advance, which is outside the learner line.
reviewNotes.level: Seven pieces, one quiet answer and a visible gain of rook for bishop against the strongest reply. The starting advantage is roughly one pawn in nominal material, with active rook counterplay and no simpler direct gain.
reviewNotes.provenance: Martinez Alcantara–Bok, 2nd 3-0 Thu 17th Sep 2026, checksummed TWIC 1663. Full replay confirms exact ply 160 and previous Kf1. The drawn game continued Kf7, while Bd3 is a separate analysis.

reviews.reason: The bishop pins the opponent’s rook so the solver’s other rook can capture it, without the king recapture that refutes an immediate capture.
reviews.distinctness: The pinner protects the capture square for a different piece. The learner contrasts the ordinary rook exchange with the same rook capture after the bishop arrives.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Bc5 — Tượng Đen từ b4 đến c5, ghim Xe b6 vào Vua a7 và bảo vệ ô b6. Chẳng hạn, nếu Trắng chơi Kb8, Đen bắt Xe bằng Rxb6+.
hintsVi: Nếu Đen bắt Xe b6 ngay, Vua Trắng có thể bắt lại.
Tượng b4 có thể đến ô nào để vừa ghim Xe b6 vừa bảo vệ ô bắt quân?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bc5 aligns c5–b6–a7. White’s rook loses its file escapes and cannot take the black rook on f6. The black bishop now covers b6.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared 22 legal roots. Rxb6 Kxb6 is an even rook trade; Rxg6 hxg6 is adverse, and Rf7+ Bxf7+ loses the rook. Rf8 Re6 and the other quiet roots yield no short gain.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All twelve legal replies permit Rxb6 with at least +400 through immediate recovery. Neither attacker is offered after Bc5. Deepest Ka6 Bxb6 Be8 leaves the full rook gain, and the legal Rxb6+ can concede h5 while retaining +400.
reviewNotes.level: Eight pieces. The sole short material-gaining answer is a quiet creating move. After any legal reply, the rook on f6 can safely take b6.
reviewNotes.provenance: Kollars–Sitbon, 2nd 3-0 Thu 6th Aug 2026. Checksummed complete game reaches ply 157 after Rb6. The game continued ...Rf8, so ...Bc5 is teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: Qa8 uniquely stops the rook’s active checks and wins the rook outright in a balanced endgame.
reviews.distinctness: A Black queen travels from one corner to the other and pins along the long diagonal. The defensive point is stopping the White rook from giving repeated file checks to the Black king, unlike Qd8 where the nearby king can immediately countercapture a pawn. The strongest King move Kf3 stays on the diagonal and Qxb7+ still works.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Qa8 — Hậu đen từ a1 đến a8, ghim Xe b7 vào Vua g2. Xe trắng không thể sang c7 để chiếu Vua đen. Nếu Trắng đi Kf3, Đen bắt Xe bằng Qxb7+.
hintsVi: Xe trắng có thể sang c7 để chiếu nếu chưa bị ghim.
Tìm đường chéo đi qua Xe b7 và Vua trắng g2.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qa8 creates a new diagonal pin along a8–b7–g2 and forbids actual rook escapes such as Rc7+. Without the pin the rook can check along the c-file or win the f7 pawn. After the pin the rook cannot move diagonally.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 27 legal roots compared and only Qa8 meets the finite material goal. Qa2 and Qf6 allow Rc7+ without gain. Qc3 allows Rxf7; the game continuation Qc3 Rc7 Qxc7 depends on a cooperative White reply. Qh1+ allows Nxh1, Qg1+ Kxg1 and Qf1+ Kxf1. No immediate mate or legal initial capture.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Every one of the 14 legal replies allows Qxb7 or Qxb7+ with +500 cp material through the next opponent reply. No capture of the queen is legal after Qa8. Deep Kf3 and Nh3 lines retain the full rook gain. The Kg1 line can later allow Nxh6 but still retains +400 cp until recovering the knight.
reviewNotes.level: Nine pieces, near-balanced starting material and one quiet queen move with no offer. The subsequent single capture is visible across all replies and does not require a second learner move.
reviewNotes.provenance: Bortnyk–Erigaisi, 1st 3-0 Thu 21st May 2026. Checksummed TWIC 1646 game replays to exact ply 145 after Kg2. Black played Qc3. Qa8 is a separate teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: Rf5 creates the pin and makes the knight capture safe. If White’s king goes after the rook, the rook itself captures the knight and is protected by Ne6.
reviews.distinctness: The two attackers are a rook and a knight. On Ke4 or Kg4, Nxf4 would let the king take the stationary rook. Rxf4+ both escapes that attack and collects the pinned knight, unlike Re3 in Jannur–Devaev where the rook and bishop simply cover the capture square.
reviews.solutionVi: Rf5 — Xe từ e5 đến f5, ghim Mã f4 vào Vua f3. Nếu Vua Trắng sang e4, Đen bắt Mã bằng ...Rxf4+. Mã e6 bảo vệ Xe trên f4.
hintsVi: Quan sát Mã f4 và Vua f3 trên cột f.
Sau khi ghim Mã f4, nếu Vua Trắng tấn công Xe, quân nào nên bắt Mã?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The rook on f5 cuts off genuine knight escapes including Nd3 and Ng2. An immediate Nxf4 allows Kxf4 and gives no material gain. Rf5 keeps the target available and supports a safe capture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 25 roots compared. Nc5 allows Ng2, Ng5+ permits Kg2, Rc5 allows Nxe6, and the direct Nxf4 allows an even trade. No second root forces a short material gain or a mating shortcut.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 16 first replies and one subsequent defence rechecked with a minimum +220 cp. Neither pinner nor knight can be captured directly after Rf5. Ke4 or Kg4 attacks the pinner, and Rxf4+ escapes while Ne6 guards f4. Supplemental 1M-node probes of Ke4 Rxf4+ Ke5, Rh1 and Rg1 found material-preserving continuations. The c-pawn race sometimes induces an optional later knight trade, but that is not required for the immediate gain.
reviewNotes.level: Beginner. Ten pieces and one quiet pin creation. The only follow-up choice is whether the rook should move away by taking or leave the knight to capture. The alternate captures both retain a visible material advantage when appropriate.
reviewNotes.provenance: Ocampos–Papasimakopoulos, Titled Tue 16th Apr, 2026-04-16. TWIC 1641 replay reaches the exact frame after 46.Kf3 and Black played 46...Rf5 at ply 91, the last recorded move. IM Black in source, archive checksum verified. The Ke4 follow-up is illustrative.

reviews.reason: The bishop uses a long diagonal to pin an active rook to a king that cannot approach the capture square in time.
reviews.distinctness: A distant king and three independent pawn pushes make this an example of capturing with check when the king remains on the diagonal. Unlike the exchange-gain examples, the king cannot recover the bishop.
reviews.solutionVi: Bc2 — Tượng từ d1 đến c2, ghim Xe e4 vào Vua h7. Nếu Đen chơi …c6, Trắng bắt Xe bằng Bxe4+ và chiếu Vua.
hintsVi: Tìm đường chéo qua Xe e4 và Vua h7.
Tượng Trắng có thể đến ô nào trên đường chéo đó?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bc2 aligns c2–e4–h7. The unpinned rook can escape along its rank, as shown by Bb3 Rh4.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: Compared all 15 legal roots. Kc3 Kg7, Kd3 Rf4 and Bb3 Rh4 retain the opposing rook. No capture or mate bypass.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal capture of the bishop after Bc2. All eleven replies permit Bxe4 or Bxe4+ for a full rook. Deepest ...Kg8 Bxe4 b6 preserves +500 before subsequent pawn trades.
reviewNotes.level: Ten pieces. One quiet bishop move reverses a material deficit and the capture is clear, with no sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Averin–Iljiushenok, Aeroflot Open A 2026. Exact ply 84 after ...Kxh7. Bc2 is played in the complete checksummed game.

reviews.reason: The quiet bishop move creates the only winning pin, securing a whole rook or the exchange in a balanced six-piece ending.
reviews.distinctness: The only initial capture, Rxg6+, is tempting because the knight sits next to the White king, but it trades the rook for a knight. Pinning the knight’s rook defender gives an immediate better capture. Six pieces and no pawns keep the decision about the pieces alone.
reviews.solutionVi: Bd4 — Tượng trắng từ e3 đến d4, ghim Xe f6 vào Vua g7. Nếu Đen đi Kf7, Trắng bắt Xe bằng Bxf6. Sau Kxf6, Trắng vẫn lời vì đổi Tượng lấy Xe.
hintsVi: Nếu Xe trắng bắt Mã g6, Xe đen f6 có thể bắt lại.
Tìm đường chéo đi qua Xe f6 và Vua đen g7.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bd4 creates a new d4–f6–g7 pin. The rook would otherwise retreat off the diagonal, as Ra5 Rd6 or Kg4 Ra6 show.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 21 legal roots compared. Rxg6+ Rxg6 loses the exchange, Bc5 Rf4 does not retain a short gain against the other legal defences, and Bb6 permits Rxb6. No competing material answer or immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All five legal replies give Bxf6, with check after Kh8. Only Kf7 permits immediate Kxf6, leaving +170 cp, and Nf8 gives no recovery of the rook in the deeper line. Against Kf8, Bxf6 Ne7 Bxe7+ Kxe7 still leaves +490 cp. No legal capture of the bishop exists after Bd4.
reviewNotes.level: Six pieces, near-equal material, one quiet bishop move. The full rook or exchange gain is visible on the next turn.
reviewNotes.provenance: Nakamura–Davudov, Titled Tue 17th Mar 2026, checksummed TWIC 1637. Replay reaches exact ply 156 after Rf6. Bd4 Kf7 Bxf6 was played; the game chose Nf4+ instead of the illustrative Kxf6.

reviews.reason: Qf2 lines up the f4 bishop with its king. The move wins a bishop from nearly equal nominal material, and the remaining bishop and passed pawns cannot recover it.
reviews.distinctness: A queen pins a bishop along a file in a queen-versus-two-bishops endgame. The other bishop can move to f5 without rescuing the pinned piece. Published Qd8 pins a rook on a diagonal and allows the king to take an outside pawn after capture.
reviews.solutionVi: Qf2 — Hậu từ h4 đến f2, ghim Tượng f4 vào Vua f7. Trong ván đấu, Đen đưa Tượng còn lại đến f5, rồi Trắng bắt Tượng f4 bằng Qxf4.
hintsVi: Tìm cột có cả Tượng f4 và Vua f7.
Hậu có thể vào cột đó ở đâu để Tượng f4 không còn đường thoát?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The queen on f2 ties the bishop to Kf7 along the f-file. None of the bishop’s geometric escapes, including Be5 and Bg5, can preserve that cover. White did not have a safe direct capture of f4.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 19 legal roots compared. Kf2 and Qd8 allow Kg6 without a material gain. The checks Qh5+ and Qh7+ allow Kf6. Qxg4 loses the queen to Bxg4. No other root secures a short material gain.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 12 legal first replies allow Qxf4 or Qxf4+ with +330 cp through the next reply. There is no legal capture of the queen after Qf2. Deeper lines retain the bishop gain after Bf5, while d4 and g3 meet Qxf4+ and the promotion threat can be removed by Qxd4 or Kxg3 as appropriate.
reviewNotes.level: Beginner. Seven pieces, one quiet queen move, nominal starting edge only 40 cp. The target bishop cannot move along the pin line, and the material gain is shown with one capture.
reviewNotes.provenance: Stotyn–Dobrikov, grenke Chess Open, 2026-04-03. Exact TWIC 1639 replay after 58...Kf7, with the played 59.Qf2 at source ply 116 and ...Bf5 Qxf4 following. CM White and IM Black in the archived source, with archive checksum.

reviews.reason: A sparse genuine game isolates the rank pin and immediate bishop gain even against the sole passed-pawn advance.
reviews.distinctness: At five pieces this is the simplest game-board rank pin in the set. Ra4 pins a bishop across a three-square span on each side. The isolated h-pawn has a legal advance, unlike the blocked pawns in fe099d291bce7e01, but the capture comes with check if Black tries it. The case isolates that single counterplay from the two-pawn race in 2709e348d6b6771b.
reviews.solutionVi: Ra4 — Xe trắng từ a2 đến a4, ghim Tượng d4 vào Vua g4. Nếu Đen đẩy tốt đến h5, Rxd4+ vừa bắt Tượng vừa chiếu. Nếu Vua đen rời hàng 4, Xe vẫn bắt được Tượng ở d4.
hintsVi: Tượng d4 và Vua g4 nằm trên cùng một hàng.
Xe có thể lên hàng 4 từ cột a.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Ra4 creates the a4–d4–g4 pin. The bishop can otherwise escape with Be3 or Be5 as against Ra6 or Ra3. It cannot stay on the pin line when moving.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 15 legal roots compared. Ra6 Be3 and Ra3 Be5 let the bishop escape, while Rf2 Bxf2 Kxf2 loses the exchange. The king moves permit bishop counterplay. No initial capture or immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All six legal replies allow Rxd4 with or without check. All six also have deeper engine evidence. The strongest Kf5 Rxd4 h5 Rh4 and Kf4 Rxd4+ Ke3 Ra4 retain the bishop gain. No capture of the pinning rook is possible.
reviewNotes.level: Five pieces, near-equal starting material and one quiet rook move with a clean piece gain. No sacrifice or recovery complication.
reviewNotes.provenance: Javakhadze–Vlassov, Titled Tue 5th May 2026, checksummed TWIC 1644. Exact ply 112 after Bxd4. White played Ra4 Kf5 Rxd4. The h5 response is a teaching variation, while the full game was drawn.

reviews.reason: Bc1 secures the knight at once despite Black’s advanced passed b-pawn and active knight attacks on f2.
reviews.distinctness: The bishop retreats to the back rank to immobilize an attacking knight. The white king is tempted to hunt either queenside pawn, but ...Ne4 attacks f2 and forces a trade. Black can still push a passed b-pawn, and the bishop capture arrives with check before it can advance again.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Bc1 — Tượng trắng từ b2 đến c1, ghim Mã d2 vào Vua h6. Nếu Đen đẩy tốt đến b3, Bxd2+ vừa bắt Mã vừa chiếu.
hintsVi: Nhìn đường chéo đi qua Mã d2 và Vua đen h6.
Tượng trắng có thể lùi về hàng 1 để tấn công Mã trên đường chéo đó.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bc1 creates c1–d2–h6 pin and stops knight jumps including Ne4, which otherwise threatens f2. The knight has no legal move on the diagonal.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 22 roots compared. Nxg6 Kxg6 loses a knight for a pawn. In the supplementary 800k probes Kb6 Ne4 Kxa6 Nxf2 and Kc5 Ne4+ Kxb4 Nxf2 exchange pawns rather than win one immediately. Nd3 allows b3 or Nc4. The best reply to Nd3 b3 is Bc1 using the same pin; other gains take longer. No immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All seven legal replies permit Bxd2 or Bxd2+ and retain +320 cp after the next reply. After b3 Bxd2+ the supplemental 800k probe also checks Kh5 and g5, each answered Bc1 to contain the passer while preserving the knight gain. No capture of the bishop on c1 is possible at the root.
reviewNotes.level: Ten pieces, one clear retreat with no sacrifice and a visible knight gain. White starts a minor piece ahead for a pawn, but Black has a live passed b-pawn, active knight and counterplay against f2.
reviewNotes.provenance: Nazin–Pham Le Thao Nguyen, Titled Tue 21st Apr 2026, checksummed TWIC 1642. Full replay confirms ply 114 after Kh6. The game continued Kb6. Bc1 is a separate teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: Be5 ties the rook to its king and wins at least the exchange immediately. The continuation can hold the gain against the passed h-pawn without giving up the remaining knight.
reviews.distinctness: The opponent can approach via Kg2 or Kh3 and limit the gain to the exchange. Black’s remaining knight restrains the h-pawn, so the compensation is a passed-pawn race rather than a recapture of the pinner or a same-file pawn attack.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Be5 — Tượng từ d4 đến e5, ghim Xe g3 vào Vua h2. Nếu Trắng đi Kg2, Đen đáp ...Bxg3. Sau Kxg3, Đen đã đổi Tượng lấy Xe.
hintsVi: Tìm đường chéo đi qua Xe g3 và Vua h2.
Tượng có thể ghim Xe từ ô nào để Xe không thể chạy khỏi đường chéo?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Be5 creates an absolute pin down e5–f4–g3–h2 and stops genuine rook escapes such as Rg8 or Rf3. The rook has no legal move along that diagonal. It is not already under a winning capture before the root.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 27 legal roots compared. The game’s immediate Nf5 allows Rg6+, Ke5 allows Rg8, and Bf6 allows Re3+. None guarantees a short material win. Bg1+ even allows Rxg1.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All five replies allow a safe Bxg3 or Bxg3+, with at least +170 cp after White’s immediate recapture. No capture of e5 is legal after the root. In the stronger Kg2 Bxg3 Kxg3 Nf5+ Kg4 branch, a 1M-node comparison found ...d4 h5 ...d3 with the exchange gain maintained until Black promotes. After h5 Bxg3+ Kxg3, supplemental lines with ...Nf5+ or ...Kf6 also retain it. The optional knight offer seen in one engine PV is not needed.
reviewNotes.level: Beginner. Seven pieces and a single quiet pin. The cleanest defensive recapture still displays the simple rook-for-bishop gain. The endgame pawn race is independent of the introductory capture.
reviewNotes.provenance: Mammadzada–Rosen, Titled Thu 19th Mar, 2026-03-19. Both IM in TWIC 1637. Exact full game at ply 117 after 59.Kh2 with archive checksum. The actual game played 59...Nf5. Be5 at this exact frame is labeled analysis.

reviews.reason: The pin turns a nearly balanced rook-versus-bishop ending into a direct gain. White’s a-pawn is one push from the seventh rank, and the pin lets Black collect the bishop with check while keeping time to stop that pawn.
reviews.distinctness: Compare the clean, pawn-locked Reprintsev Ra4 and the earlier Rb6 pin with a less advanced passed pawn. Here the king must be ready to stop a pawn already on a6, and Rxe3+ gains the tempo needed to do so.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Rf3 — Xe từ f7 đến f3, ghim Tượng e3 vào Vua b3. Nếu Trắng đẩy a7, Đen bắt Tượng bằng Rxe3+. Chẳng hạn, sau Kc4, Đen đi Kb7 để chặn tốt a.
hintsVi: Tìm hàng ngang đi qua cả Tượng e3 và Vua b3.
Nếu Trắng đẩy tốt lên a7, Xe có thể bắt Tượng kèm chiếu không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rf3 creates the f3–e3–b3 pin and prevents the bishop from escaping to a7, d4 or g5 while the king stays on b3. The rook collects it after any legal move.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 20 roots checked with no immediate mate. Rb7+ axb7 loses the rook for a pawn. The stronger quiet Rf5 only wins a pawn in a much later branch, and actual Kb5 needs multiple king and rook moves before taking the pawn. Neither wins material in the short teaching horizon.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal capture after Rf3. Seven king replies and a7 all allow Rxe3 or Rxe3+ with +330 cp through the immediate response. The strongest a7 Rxe3+ Kc4 Kb7 line lets the king stop a8=Q, and Kc3 Rxe3+ lines cover promotion with Re8 and ...Rxa8. No recovery of the bishop.
reviewNotes.level: Seven pieces, one quiet pin-creating move, no offer, and a check on the capture if the pawn pushes.
reviewNotes.provenance: Klukin–Oberoi, 2nd 3-0 Thu 9th Apr 2026, complete checksum-bound TWIC 1640 game. Exact ply 109 after Be3. ...Kb5 was played; Rf3 is analysis.

reviews.reason: Bb5 creates a clear diagonal pin and wins the knight even when White moves its bishop rather than its king.
reviews.distinctness: The opponent’s bishop is on the opposite square color and cannot contest the pin line. White can move that bishop to many squares, but none lets it defend the knight on c4. The learner recognizes the pin independently of king displacement.
reviews.solutionVi: Thế cờ biên soạn. Bb5 — Tượng đen từ e8 đến b5, ghim Mã c4 vào Vua f1. Tượng trắng đi trên các ô khác màu nên không thể bảo vệ Mã ở c4. Chẳng hạn, sau Bd6, Đen bắt Mã bằng Bxc4+.
hintsVi: Tìm đường chéo đi qua Mã c4 và Vua trắng f1.
Tượng trắng có thể đi tới hoặc bảo vệ ô c4 không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bb5 creates the b5–c4–f1 pin. Nd6 and Ne3 are real escapes against Bf7 and Bc6. No knight move is legal after Bb5.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 14 legal roots compared. King moves allow Nd6, Bc6 permits Ne3, Nf6 allows Bxf6 and the forcing Ng3+ allows Bxg3. No legal starting capture, immediate mate or alternative short material gain.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 18 replies allow Bxc4 or Bxc4+ for +320 cp through the next legal reply. There are no capture offers after Bb5. The deeper Bb8 Bxc4+ Kf2 and Bc7 Bxc4+ Kf2 lines retain the knight; several longer lines defer the safe capture without changing the immediate payoff.
reviewNotes.level: Seven pieces, material initially one pawn apart, one quiet bishop move. All replies leave a single clear knight capture.
reviewNotes.provenance: Original composition, verified from the exact legal starting FEN. No source game or preceding move.

reviews.reason: A nearly balanced eight-piece composition. Ba3 traps the rook, and the second bishop controls the promotion square of Black’s advanced e-pawn.
reviews.distinctness: Compared with the published Samunenkov–Tahmasebi Bb7, White here has two bishops with distinct jobs. One makes the pin and can be traded for the rook; the other guards e1 while White retains a passed g-pawn. This demonstrates the exchange without ignoring the pawn counterplay.
reviews.solutionVi: Ba3 — Tượng từ d6 đến a3, ghim Xe b2 vào Vua c1. Nếu Đen đi e2, Trắng bắt Xe bằng Bxb2+. Sau Kxb2, Trắng đã đổi Tượng lấy Xe, còn Tượng g3 khống chế ô phong cấp e1.
hintsVi: Tìm đường chéo đi qua Xe b2 và Vua c1.
Tượng nào có thể ghim Xe? Tượng còn lại đang khống chế ô phong cấp nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Ba3 creates the a3–b2–c1 absolute pin. The rook otherwise has safe moves such as Rb7+ and cannot move diagonally along the new pin line.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 21 roots reviewed, with no immediate mate. Ba3 is the sole exact short material result. g6 Kd1 permits rook counterplay without winning material. Bdf4 lets the rook check on b7; tested gain against weaker ...h4 does not establish the same short result against that check.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal capture of Ba3 or Bg3 after the pin. All six replies allow Bxb2 or Bxb2+ with at least +170 cp through the next reply. Targeted direct capture probes after ...e2 and ...h4 covered all king replies. In the strongest ...e2 Bxb2+ Kxb2 race, Bg3 meets e1=Q and the remaining g-pawn can promote after the exchange. The e-pawn does not refute the exchange.
reviewNotes.level: Eight pieces, one quiet pin-creating move, no offer. Even when Black retakes the bishop, the exchange is visible immediately.
reviewNotes.provenance: Original composition. No source game or previous move.

reviews.reason: Rd7 creates the only short material-winning move. If White’s bishop attacks the rook on d7, the rook escapes the attack by taking the pinned knight with check.
reviews.distinctness: Black uses a central file to pin the knight. White’s other minor piece can attack the pinner via Ba4 or Bf5, which makes Rxd6+ both a safe retreat and a material win. In the published Rf1 example the relevant response is a king move or pawn advance, and the white rook is not newly attacked by a bishop.
reviews.solutionVi: Thế cờ sáng tác. Rd7 — Xe từ e7 đến d7, ghim Mã d6 vào Vua d2. Nếu Trắng đi Ba4 tấn công Xe, Đen đáp ...Rxd6+, vừa bắt Mã vừa chiếu Vua.
hintsVi: Quan sát Mã d6 và Vua d2 trên cột d.
Nếu Tượng Trắng tấn công Xe sau khi Mã bị ghim, Xe có thể bắt quân nào để thoát khỏi đòn tấn công?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The rook on d7 pins Nd6 to Kd2, removing real escapes including Nc4+ and Nf5. The move is quiet, attacks the knight, and immediately blocks those escapes.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 19 roots compared. b5 permits Nxb5, Rc7 permits Ba4, Re6 allows Nc4+, and Ka2 does not win material against Bf5. No other root supplies a comparable short gain or mating shortcut.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: Every one of the 14 legal replies permits a safe Rxd6 or Rxd6+ and retains +320 cp through the next reply. No capture of d7 is legal immediately. The bishop attacks d7 after Ba4 or Bf5, and Rxd6+ moves the rook out of danger. Supplementary 1M-node lines after Ba4, Bf5 and Be4 show material-preserving moves, including after Be4 Rxd6+ Ke3 b5 or Kc3. Optional later rook exchanges to promote are unnecessary.
reviewNotes.level: Beginner. Seven pieces, one quiet non-sacrificial move, approximately balanced starting material, and a direct capture visible against every defence.
reviewNotes.provenance: Original composition pin-composed-a4bb939ad1ecc472. Exact FEN and move checked, without game attribution or preceding move.

reviews.reason: The five-piece pin turns an equal rook exchange into a full rook gain. The pinner protects the capture square for either attacker depending on the king’s approach.
reviews.distinctness: Unlike the earlier Kollars pin, the pinner is itself the natural capture after some king moves. Ke4 makes the stationary rook’s capture necessary because the king threatens f5 and can recapture a bishop on e5.
reviews.solutionVi: Bf6 — Tượng Đen từ h4 đến f6, ghim Xe e5 vào Vua d4. Nếu Trắng chơi Ke4, Đen bắt bằng Rxe5+ vì Tượng f6 bảo vệ ô e5.
hintsVi: Nếu Đen chơi Rxe5 ngay, Vua Trắng có thể bắt lại.
Tượng h4 đến đâu để vừa ghim Xe e5 vừa bảo vệ ô e5?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bf6 pins Re5 to Kd4. The rook cannot make its normal file escape or capture on f5 without exposing the king.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 13 roots reviewed. Rxe5 Kxe5 is an even rook trade and Bf2+ Ke4 Rxe5+ Kxe5 also trades the rooks. Kg4 Rxf5 Kxf5 does not win material.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All seven legal replies permit a full rook gain with no immediate recovery. No offer is capturable immediately. After Ke4, both e5 and the stationary rook f5 are attacked, and ...Rxe5+ uses Bf6’s protection. After Kc5, ...Bxe5 is safe. The deep Ke4 line preserves the full rook gain through the principal exchange stage.
reviewNotes.level: Five pieces and a direct pin. The worked example shows the correct capture against a king that approaches.
reviewNotes.provenance: Boikov–Dang, Titled Tue 21st Oct 2025, exact ply 141 after Re5. The checksummed complete game has ...Bf6.

reviews.reason: Ra2 simultaneously saves the attacked rook and traps the knight that threatened it.
reviews.distinctness: Unlike the earlier Ra2 pawn pin, the knight itself attacks the rook on a1 and defends the pawn on a3. Moving to a2 avoids Nxa1 and converts the threat into a pin. Capturing the tempting a3 pawn immediately loses the rook.
reviews.solutionVi: Ra2 — Xe đen từ a1 đến a2, vừa tránh nước Nxa1 vừa ghim Mã c2 vào Vua f2. Nếu Trắng đi Kf3, Đen bắt Mã bằng Rxc2.
hintsVi: Mã trắng c2 đang tấn công Xe a1 và bảo vệ tốt a3.
Tìm ô để Xe vừa tránh bị bắt, vừa ghim Mã vào Vua trắng.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Ra2 creates a2–c2–f2 pin on the knight that attacked a1. Rc1 Ne3 shows that merely leaving the attacked square allows the knight to escape.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 18 legal roots compared. Rxa3 Nxa3 and Rf1+ Kxf1 lose the rook. Rb1 and Rh1 give no safe gain after their strongest replies. No immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 11 legal replies allow Rxc2 or Rxc2+, preserving the full knight. No capture of the rook exists after Ra2. The deep Kf3, h4 and a4 lines preserve at least +320 cp, including active pawn play.
reviewNotes.level: Eight pieces, initially near equal, one clear counterattacking rook move with immediate piece gain.
reviewNotes.provenance: Dumanuly–Shuvalov, Titled Tue 9th Dec 2025, checksummed TWIC 1623. Exact ply 115 and previous Nxc2. Ra2 Kf3 Rxc2 was played.

reviews.reason: Bc7 stops the rook escaping and lets White win the rook or trade bishop for rook. The strongest recapture is the short transition actually played, leaving White the only remaining pawn, an outside passer.
reviews.distinctness: A five-piece bishop-versus-rook ending with one pawn in total. After the pin, the defender can take the bishop back, deliberately entering a pawn ending. Unlike the previous bishop-pins-rook examples with other pieces or counter-passers, there is no later material recovery through a second pawn or piece.
reviews.solutionVi: Bc7 — Tượng từ a5 đến c7, ghim Xe d6 vào Vua e5. Trong ván đấu, Đen đáp ...Kd5. Sau Bxd6 Kxd6, Trắng đổi được Tượng lấy Xe và giữ tốt thông b4.
hintsVi: Quan sát Xe d6 và Vua e5 trên cùng một đường chéo.
Nếu Vua Đen đến d5, đổi Tượng lấy Xe sẽ để lại thế cờ nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bc7 creates an absolute pin on c7–d6–e5. Before the pin, the rook can escape via a file or rank move such as Rd7 or Rg6. The bishop attacks it from c7 and the rook cannot move along that diagonal.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All nine legal roots checked. b5 permits ...Rg6 and ...Rd7+, and Bb6 permits ...Rxb6+. Kc7 also allows ...Rg6. Bd8 loses to ...Rxd8. No other root forces the short gain or a mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All seven legal replies allow a safe Bxd6 or Bxd6+, at least +170 cp. No legal capture of the bishop immediately after Bc7. Kd5 and Ke6 allow Kxd6 only after the bishop has taken the rook. The game follows Kd5 Bxd6 Kxd6, and a supplemental 1M-node MultiPV probe of this ending retains the pawn and promotes it along several routes.
reviewNotes.level: Beginner. Five pieces, one quiet pin, material near balanced before the pin, and a direct capture even under the strongest king approach.
reviewNotes.provenance: Bulmaga–Schulze, European Women Rapid, 2026-01-10. Exact TWIC 1627 replay at ply 144 after 72...Kxe5. The game played 73.Bc7 Kd5 74.Bxd6 Kxd6. IM and FM in the source, archive checksum verified.

reviews.reason: A nearly balanced ten-piece original game position. Rh6 stops a pawn advance through an absolute rank pin and creates the only clear short gain. The original game also shows how the rook keeps a pawn when Black attacks the other wing.
reviews.distinctness: Unlike the published pawn pin Ra2, the moving rook pins an ordinary pawn that can legally escape via f5 before the tactic. The rook wins that pawn while the attacking black king forces a concrete pawn trade across the board. The decision teaches that the pinned pawn can no longer use its normal one-square advance.
reviews.solutionVi: Rh6 — Xe từ h7 đến h6, ghim tốt f6 vào Vua c6. Tốt không thể tiến lên f5. Ván đấu tiếp diễn ...Kb5 Rxf6 Ka4 Rc6 Kxa3 Rxc5. Trắng giữ mức lãi một tốt.
hintsVi: Tìm hàng ngang đi qua tốt f6 và Vua c6.
Nếu Xe đứng trên hàng đó, tốt f6 còn có thể tiến lên f5 không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rh6 pins the f6-pawn to Kc6 across the sixth rank. Without the rook on that rank the pawn can escape a direct capture by advancing f5.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 15 roots checked, with no immediate mate. The only initial capture Rxf7 Bxf7 loses the exchange. A separate exhaustive local search extending to three solver turns found no second retained material move. Quiet moves leave the f6-pawn or allow counterplay.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal capture of Rh6. Every one of 18 replies admits Rxf6 or Rxf6+ with +100 through the immediate opponent reply. The toughest king route Kb5 Rxf6 Ka4 attacks a3. The actual Rc6 Kxa3 Rxc5 replaces the pawn and the targeted 1.4M probe retains +100 against Kb4. After Kb5 Rxf6 Be6, Rf4 cuts the king off from a4 and preserves the pawn gain in the tested line. No claim that the extra pawn wins the game.
reviewNotes.level: Ten pieces, no offer and one straightforward pin to win the pawn on the next move. The extra sequence documents the strong king counterplay after that gain.
reviewNotes.provenance: Nguyen Ngoc Truong Son–Mitul K H, Titled Tue 16th Dec 2025, complete checksum-bound TWIC 1624 game. Ply 72 after ...Bc4; Rh6 and the entire solution continuation were played.

reviews.reason: Bf6 wins the knight from a balanced ending, even when the defender interposes a pawn to release the pin.
reviews.distinctness: Black’s bishop pins a knight on a diagonal supported by its king. White can play c3 to cut the line and remove the check from Bxe5, but spending its turn on the pawn does not save the knight. This uses a pawn interposition in a genuine game, while the composition Ra2 uses a second bishop.
reviews.solutionVi: Bf6 — Tượng đen từ e7 đến f6, ghim Mã e5 vào Vua b2. Nếu Trắng đẩy tốt đến c3 để chắn đường chéo, Đen vẫn bắt được Mã bằng Bxe5.
hintsVi: Nhìn đường chéo đi qua Mã e5 và Vua trắng b2.
Nếu tốt trắng lên c3, Mã e5 có rời ô được ngay không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bf6 creates the f6–e5–b2 pin and stops jumps such as Ng4 and Nc4. A c3 pawn interposition ends the pin without moving the target or blocking the bishop capture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 19 legal roots compared. Bd6 Ng4, Kf6 Nc4 and Bd8 Nd7 allow the knight to leave. Ba3+ Kxa3 loses the bishop, while g5 provides no immediate gain. No legal initial capture or immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 12 replies allow Bxe5 or Bxe5+, preserving +320 cp through the next reply. No captures of the bishop are available. Kc3 Bxe5+ Kc4 and Kb3 Bxe5 a4 preserve the full material gain in deeper review.
reviewNotes.level: Ten pieces, nearly identical material and one simple diagonal move. The capture remains visible even when White interposes.
reviewNotes.provenance: Manvelyan–Ashraf, 1st 3-0 Thu 4th Dec 2025, checksummed TWIC 1622. Exact ply 75 after Ne5. Bf6 was the last move in the game; c3 is an illustrative reply.

reviews.reason: Ra2 is the one safe rook landing on the line through the bishop and the king. Both neighbouring destinations lose the rook to the same bishop. The pin then wins the bishop even when the king leaves the rank or White starts a pawn advance.
reviews.distinctness: This is an edge-square pin where the rook finishes immediately next to the bishop. The useful choice is distinguishing a2 from both bishop-controlled a1 and a3. The existing Ra2 pawn exercise starts its rook on a1 and prevents a pawn from advancing c3 or c4, with neither of these bishop-capture alternatives.
reviews.solutionVi: Ra2 — Xe từ a7 đến a2, ghim Tượng b2 vào Vua g2. Chọn a2 để tránh hai ô a1 và a3 do Tượng b2 khống chế. Trong ván đấu, Trắng đi Kg3 và Đen bắt Tượng bằng ...Rxb2.
hintsVi: Tượng b2 khống chế cả a1 lẫn a3. Hãy tìm một ô khác trên cột a.
Vua g2 đứng cùng hàng với Tượng b2. Xe có thể tận dụng hàng đó như thế nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Ra2 ties Bb2 to Kg2 on rank two and cuts off genuine bishop escapes including Bc1, Bc3 and Bd4. Since the rook is adjacent on the same rank, the bishop cannot take it along a diagonal.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 19 legal roots compared. e5 permits Kg3, and Rb7 and Ra5 permit Bd4 without a short gain. Ra1 allows Bxa1 and Ra3 allows Bxa3. There is no shorter safe capture or mating route.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 11 legal replies permit Rxb2 or Rxb2+ with at least +330 cp through the next response. No legal capture of Ra2 after the pin. Reviewed king and pawn moves, including actual Kg3 Rxb2 and e4 Rxb2+. No deeper reply recovers the bishop gain. The g5 line trades the f6 pawn and recaptures it with Kxf6.
reviewNotes.level: Beginner. Ten pieces, one quiet rook move, nearly equal material at the start. The adjacent bishop’s threats to a1 and a3 make the safe pin square a concrete decision.
reviewNotes.provenance: Mendes Aaron Reeve–Gontcharov, 3rd 3-0 Thu, 2026-02-12. Complete TWIC 1632 replay reaches 44.Bxb2 at ply 87, with played 44...Ra2 45.Kg3 Rxb2. IM White in source, archive checksum verified.

reviews.reason: Played source. The rook briefly leaves the file of an advanced passed pawn to capture the pinned bishop with check, then returns in time to prevent a lasting promotion.
reviews.distinctness: Ter Sahakyan–Vershinin Rc8 also uses a capture with check against an advanced passed pawn, but the king deals with that pawn. Here the key decision is whether the same rook can take a bishop off the c-file and return before the c-pawn promotes safely.
reviews.solutionVi: Rc7 — Xe từ c8 đến c7, ghim Tượng d7 vào Vua h7. Trong ván đấu, Đen đẩy c2. Trắng bắt Tượng bằng Rxd7+ rồi trở lại c7 sau Kh6 để chặn tốt c.
hintsVi: Xe có thể ghim Tượng d7 trên hàng nào?
Nếu Đen đẩy c2, hãy tìm cách bắt Tượng kèm chiếu để Xe kịp quay lại cột c.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rc7 pins Bd7 to Kh7, preventing escapes and defensive captures such as Bxf5. Because it is pinned, White can capture the bishop with check when Black advances the passer.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 21 legal roots reviewed. Rh8+ Kxh8 drops the rook. Rxc3 Bxf5 exchanges pawns, and the targeted Rc6 Bb1 branch needs several more moves to find material. Exhaustive local extension to three solver turns did not find a second retained material root.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: No legal capture of Rc7. All seven replies allow Rxd7 or Rxd7+ with +330 after every immediate reply. The played c2 Rxd7+ Kh6 Rc7 maintains control. Tested ...Kg5 Rxc2 Kxf5 retains +330; if Black promotes on c1, the rook takes the new piece. After Kg7 Rxd7+ Kf6 Rc7 Kxf5, the immediate Rxc3 replaces the pawn.
reviewNotes.level: Ten pieces, one pin-creating rook move and no offer. The bishop capture is visible on the next turn and comes with check if the pawn advances.
reviewNotes.provenance: Yilmaz–Anand, World Rapid 2025, checksum-bound complete TWIC 1625 game. Ply 74 after ...Bxd7. Rc7 c2 Rxd7+ Kh6 Rc7 was played.

reviews.reason: Qe8 is the only direct way to win the rook and prevent the passer from obtaining counterplay. The white king protects the queen’s capture square.
reviews.distinctness: The queen pins a rook that is guarded by the defending king. The white king already attacks c6, and this protection makes Qxc6 safe after Kc5. The passed pawn can reach c2 but the queen captures the rook with check first. This is a guarded capture, unlike the clean Qa8 and Qd8 rook gains.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Qe8 — Hậu trắng từ e3 đến e8, ghim Xe c6 vào Vua b5. Vua trắng b7 bảo vệ ô c6. Nếu Đen đẩy tốt đến c2, Qxc6+ bắt Xe và chiếu, rồi Hậu có thể bắt tốt bằng Qxc2.
hintsVi: Tìm đường chéo đi qua Xe c6 và Vua đen b5.
Vua trắng b7 đang bảo vệ ô c6.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Qe8 pins c6 to b5. The rook otherwise has an escape and tempo such as Rc4 in the actual game. After Kc5 Qxc6+ the defending king cannot capture on c6 because Kb7 protects it.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 27 legal roots compared. Qxc3 Rxc3 and Qe5+ fxe5 lose the queen. Qf3 allows Rb6+ without gain or Rc4 with live promotion counterplay. An 800k probe of Qf3 Rc4 verifies no short material payoff. g5 fxg5 Qe8 requires the same pin after conceding a pawn. No competing immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All seven replies allow Qxc6 or Qxc6+ and keep the rook gain. No capture of the queen exists after the root. Supplemental 800k checks of Kc4 Qxc6+ and c2 Qxc6+ retain +500 cp or more. After c2 Qxc6+ both king evasions allow Qxc2.
reviewNotes.level: Seven pieces and one direct queen move. The nominal queen-versus-rook material edge is offset by the supported c3 passer, and ordinary moves allow equal play or worse in the root analysis.
reviewNotes.provenance: Madaminov–Maghsoodloo, Comet Open Titled Winners, checksummed TWIC 1616. Full replay reaches exact ply 148 after c3. The game continued Qe2+; Qe8 is separate teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: The rook pins a knight that threatens a pawn and can otherwise use checking jumps.
reviews.distinctness: A vertical pin simultaneously stops the knight capturing g5 and removes its checks, with the competing rook move allowing an actual knight check.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Re7 — Xe Đen từ f7 đến e7, ghim Mã e4 vào Vua e3 và ngăn Mã bắt Tốt g5. Nếu Trắng chơi Kd3, Đen bắt Mã bằng Rxe4.
hintsVi: Mã e4 đang tấn công Tốt g5.
Tìm ô để Xe Đen ghim Mã trên cùng cột với Vua e3.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Re7 pins Ne4 to Ke3. It stops knight moves such as Nxg5 and Nf6+, and makes e4 a safe capture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 17 roots compared. Rf4 Nxg5 Rxg4 merely trades pawns. Played Rg7 allows Nf6+ and the knight escapes. Rf3+ Kxf3 loses the rook.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All six legal replies permit Rxe4 or Rxe4+ for a knight. No legal capture of the pinner. Kd3 Rxe4 Kc2 Rxg4 retains and improves the gain, and b6 Rxe4+ Kd3 Rb4 handles the outside passer.
reviewNotes.level: Seven pieces, balanced material and one quiet move. The knight has a visible independent threat on g5.
reviewNotes.provenance: Sjugirov–Haydon, 2nd 3-0 Thu 29th Jan 2026. Exact ply 139 after Ke3; the played move is ...Rg7. Re7 is labeled analysis.

reviews.reason: Ra4 is the only immediate pin that wins the knight without requiring a passed-pawn race or allowing an exchange sacrifice.
reviews.distinctness: The rank pin stops a knight whose escapes defend the e-pawn. The played Re5 is tempting, but ...Ng5 would protect e6 and prevent the expected pawn capture. Pushing the b-pawn leads to a long race rather than the pin’s immediate material decision.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Ra4 — Xe trắng từ a5 đến a4, ghim Mã e4 vào Vua h4. Nếu Đen đẩy tốt đến e5, Rxe4+ vừa bắt Mã vừa chiếu.
hintsVi: Mã e4 và Vua h4 nằm trên cùng một hàng.
So sánh việc bắt tốt h5 với việc đưa Xe xuống hàng 4.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Ra4 creates a4–e4–h4 pin. The knight has real escapes, including Ng5 after Re5, which also defends e6 against Rxe6.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 20 legal roots compared. Rxh5+ Kxh5 loses the exchange. The played Re5 permits Ng5 and has no safe early gain. Ra6 e5 leaves no immediate capture and the strongest line returns to Ra4. Supplemental 800k b4 lines require a long race before gaining material, with no simpler short alternative. No immediate mate.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All five replies permit Rxe4 or Rxe4+, retaining +320 cp through the next reply. The deep Kg5 and Kg4 lines preserve the piece gain despite opposing passed-pawn play. The rook is not offered by Ra4.
reviewNotes.level: Seven pieces, nearly even material and one quiet move, with a clear knight gain on the next turn.
reviewNotes.provenance: Mirzhanov–Chemin, Titled Tue 23rd Dec 2025, checksummed TWIC 1625. Exact ply 108 after Kxh4. The actual move was Re5; Ra4 is separate teaching analysis.

reviews.reason: The bishop pins a rook beside the king while the stationary rook covers the advanced pawn’s promotion square.
reviews.distinctness: The opponent can push a pawn to the seventh rank instead of moving the king. The checking capture and the second rook’s existing control of d8 keep the response short.
reviews.solutionVi: Phương án phân tích. Bc3 — Tượng Đen từ g7 đến c3, ghim Xe d2 vào Vua e1. Nếu Trắng chơi d7, Đen bắt Xe bằng Bxd2+. Xe f8 vẫn kiểm soát ô phong cấp d8.
hintsVi: Xe d2 đứng giữa Vua e1 và ô c3.
Nếu Tốt Trắng tiến lên d7, Xe Đen đang kiểm soát ô phong cấp nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bc3 pins Rd2 to Ke1. Moving the rook off the diagonal would expose the king. The alternative Bd4 allows Ra2.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 26 roots reviewed. Bd4 Ra2 does not trap the rook, and the played Rd8 leaves it free. Re8+ Kd1 and Rf1+ Kxf1 do not give a direct material win.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All three legal replies permit Bxd2 or Bxd2+. If Ke2 or Kd1, the king can take back but concedes the exchange. After d7 Bxd2+ Kxd2, the rook f8 still controls d8, so the passer cannot recover the material immediately. The stronger lines also maintain the exchange gain.
reviewNotes.level: Ten pieces, a single quiet pin and just three replies. The passer does not require a separate sacrifice or preparation.
reviewNotes.provenance: Hajialiyev–Martinez Alcantara, 1st 3-0 Thu 22nd Jan 2026. The complete checksummed game reaches ply 123 after Rd2 and continued ...Rd8. Bc3 is analysis.

reviews.reason: An absolute rank pin makes gxh4 safe and creates a passed h-pawn in a contested endgame.
reviews.distinctness: A rook pins a bishop, allowing a pawn to capture diagonally and create a passed pawn. When the king unpins the bishop with Kg1, the new passer can advance before Bxh4. This differs from the nearby rank pin f14c18b9827bd82e, where a rook under attack takes a pawn protected by a pinned pawn.
reviews.solutionVi: gxh4 — Tốt đen từ g5 bắt tốt ở h4. Tượng trắng f2 không thể bắt lại vì sẽ để Xe a2 chiếu Vua g2. Nếu Trắng đi Kg1 để giải ghim, Đen có thể đẩy tốt thông đến h3.
hintsVi: Quan sát hàng 2 từ Xe đen a2 đến Vua trắng g2.
Tượng f2 có thể rời hàng 2 để bắt tốt ở h4 không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The a2 rook pins the f2 bishop to the king on g2. Removing the pinner makes Bxh4 legal and erases the pawn gain, with no immediate Black recapture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 25 legal roots compared, with no mating root. Rxf2+ Kxf2 loses the exchange. g4 fxg4 Bxg4 trades pawns, and e4 Kg1 e3 Be1 allows play without an immediate gain. Bounded alternative probes do not show a simpler independent gain. Exact legal replay also ruled out a solver mate in one or forced mate in two.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 15 legal replies retain the pawn immediately. Neither the moving pawn nor the stationary rook can be captured. After Kg1 the bishop can recapture next time, but h3 moves the passer to safety. A supplementary million-node probe confirms Kg1 h3 and maintains +100 cp or more through the principal reply. ...h3+ also preserves the gain after Rf1 or Re1.
reviewNotes.level: One direct pawn capture, no sacrifice, no preparation. The single obvious king unpin is met by advancing the same pawn.
reviewNotes.provenance: Li–Rozman, 109th Edward Lasker Mem, New York, checksummed TWIC archive. Full game replay reaches exact ply 91 after h4. gxh4 Kg1 h3 was played.

reviews.reason: The queen directly wins a pawn because the rook holds the only recapturing pawn to the king. Taking immediately also blocks Black’s ability to escape the pin by castling on that turn.
reviews.distinctness: Kamalsyah–Muzis Qxd5 also uses a queen to take a pawn that a pinned pawn cannot retake. Here a rook pins along the e-file, and immediate Qxd4 takes control of d8 while slower Qd3 or Re2 permits queenside castling. The competing move therefore changes the practical status of the pin.
reviews.solutionVi: Qxd4 — Hậu từ d1 bắt tốt d4. Xe e1 ghim tốt e5 vào Vua e8, nên Đen không thể bắt lại bằng exd4. Trong ván đấu, Đen dùng Rd8 tấn công Hậu, và Trắng đáp Qe4.
hintsVi: Nhìn dọc cột e từ Xe e1 đến Vua e8. Tốt e5 đang che đường chiếu nào?
Hậu có thể bắt tốt d4 mà tốt e5 không được phép bắt lại không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Re1 pins Pe5 to Ke8. Removing Re1 after Qxd4 permits exd4, which leaves White down 800 cp relative to the adjusted initial position with no legal recapture on d4.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 27 legal roots checked, including exact mate in at most two. Rxe5+ Nxe5 drops the exchange and Qxg4 Qxg4 loses the queen. Qd3 and Re2 permit immediate O-O-O, while Qxd4 controls d8 and prevents it on that turn. The only root reaching a settled +100 in the separate three-turn local material check was Qxd4.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 28 immediate responses are non-captures, so neither queen nor pinner is offered. The stronger Bd6 Qc4 O-O-O line retains the extra pawn. After f5, the non-sacrificial Re2 Be7 Qc4 O-O-O Qxa6+ also preserves it in the targeted probe. Qh2+ and Qh1+ can be captured, and the source Rd8 Qe4 defends the queen.
reviewNotes.level: A direct one-move pawn gain with no preparation or material offer. The active queen defence can be met after the gain.
reviewNotes.provenance: Lodici–Prakhar Tripathi, Titled Tue 24th Mar 2026, complete checksum-bound TWIC 1638. Exact ply 34 after ...Qh5. Qxd4 Rd8 Qe4 was played.

reviews.reason: One direct rook capture wins a rook and removes a verified mate-in-one threat.
reviews.distinctness: The capturing rook is itself threatened by ...Rxe1#, and a second rook on d7 pins the pawn that would otherwise recapture. The pin saves the threatened rook and the king in the same move, unlike existing rook-and-pawn examples without an immediate mate threat.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxe6 — Xe trắng từ e1 bắt Xe ở e6 và hóa giải đe dọa Rxe1#. Tốt đen f7 không thể bắt lại ở e6 vì sẽ để Xe d7 chiếu Vua g7.
hintsVi: Xe đen e6 đang dọa bắt Xe e1 và chiếu hết.
Nhìn hàng 7. Nếu tốt f7 rời hàng này, Vua đen có bị chiếu không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rd7 pins f7 to Kg7. Removing Rd7 makes fxe6 legal and turns the gain into an equal rook exchange, with no immediate White recapture. With the pin, White can take the rook and deny mate in one move.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 30 legal roots compared. A null-turn check confirms the threat Rxe1# on the original board. The solver has no mating alternative. Rxa7 allows Rxe1#, Rxd4 loses to Rxe1+ Rd1 Rxd1#, and Rxf7+ Kxf7 loses the rook. Rf1 and Rd1 avoid the immediate threat but do not win material. Exact legal replay also ruled out a solver mate in one or forced mate in two.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 25 legal replies keep at least +400 cp. Neither rook is offered after Rxe6. Bxb2 is met by Kxb2, while the stronger Rb8 Ree7 and Be5 Ree7 lines keep the rook gain. In the long Rb8 line the temporary material dip after Rxb7 is immediately restored by the equal rook exchange.
reviewNotes.level: A direct capture with an already established pin. White begins a bishop down with a concrete mate threat, and wins the rook without a preparatory move or sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Samimi–Cumpe, Titled Tue 16th Dec 2025, checksummed TWIC archive. Exact ply 48 after Bxd4 confirmed from full legal replay. Rxe6 was played.

reviews.reason: Qxg5 captures the rook that was attacking the queen. The pawn on f6 cannot recapture because the stationary f1 rook pins it to the king. Checks and pawn captures cannot recover the rook gain.
reviews.distinctness: The queen answers a rook attack by taking the attacking rook one square away. Unlike the published Rxf6 pinned-pawn capture, the moving piece is the queen and is the piece directly threatened. The defender can try a checking queen counterattack or an intervening knight capture.
reviews.solutionVi: Qxg5 — Hậu từ f5 bắt Xe ở g5. Xe f1 ghim tốt f6 vào Vua f8, nên Đen không thể đáp ...fxg5. Nếu Đen đi ...Nxe5, Trắng có Qxe5.
hintsVi: Xe g5 đang tấn công Hậu f5. Tốt nào đang bảo vệ Xe g5?
Quan sát Xe f1, tốt f6 và Vua f8 trên cùng một cột.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Without the f1 rook, fxg5 becomes legal, changes the material delta from +500 to −400 cp and leaves White with no capture. The pin specifically secures the queen’s capture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 42 legal roots compared. Qe6 allows Rxe5, and Rxf6+ Bxf6 in that branch shows no quick gain in the supplemental 1M-node replay. Qh7 Nxe5 Qh8+ is met by Rg8, Qxf6+ by Bxf6, and Qc8+ by Rxc8. No simpler gain or positive forced-mate lead.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 34 replies retain at least +400 cp at the first response. Neither the moving queen nor stationary rook can be captured legally. The strong Nxe5 permits Qxe5, restoring and increasing the gain to +720 cp. Qg1+ permits Nxg1. Additional 1M-node replay after the played Ra7 confirmed exf6 and other material-preserving moves.
reviewNotes.level: A. One direct non-sacrificial capture that also saves the attacked queen. White starts a piece behind and the pin is what changes the material balance.
reviewNotes.provenance: Safin–Czerw, 1st 3-0 Thu, 2025-12-18. Complete TWIC 1624 replay reaches exact FEN after 24...Rxg5 at ply 48. The game played 25.Qxg5. IM Black in archived header. Archive checksum verified. The ...Nxe5 example is an illustrative reply.

reviews.reason: The queen can capture its opposing counterpart because the g3-pawn cannot recapture.
reviews.distinctness: The lesson is distinguishing a full queen gain from an even queen exchange. The capture also resolves the immediate threat to Qb4.
reviews.solutionVi: Qxh4 — Hậu Đen từ b4 bắt Hậu h4. Xe g5 ghim Tốt g3 vào Vua g2, nên Trắng không thể đáp gxh4. Đen thắng Hậu.
hintsVi: Tốt nào của Trắng có vẻ bảo vệ Hậu h4?
Nhìn dọc cột g để kiểm tra Tốt g3 có thể bắt lại hay không.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rg5 pins g3 to Kg2. Removing Rg5 makes gxh4 legal and restores the equal queen exchange. Black has no immediate retake on h4.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 37 legal roots checked. Rxg3+ Qxg3+ loses a rook for a pawn and Rb5 Qxb4 Rxb4 only trades queens. Quiet queen retreats retain the original contest.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 12 replies preserve the full queen gain through the next reply. There is no legal immediate capture of either attacker. Against f4, ...Rg6 Ra2 ...Qxf4 Rxa7 keeps the queen gain through the pawn exchange.
reviewNotes.level: A single safe capture wins a whole queen. There is no offer, exchange preparation or additional solver move.
reviewNotes.provenance: Tanenbaum–Dyulgerov, Titled Tue 28th Oct 2025. TWIC checksummed complete game reaches ply 85 after Qh4 and continues with ...Qxh4.

reviews.reason: Rxd5 wins the opposing rook and avoids the apparently equal rook exchange that would occur without the pin.
reviews.distinctness: An opposing rook has just captured on d5. The learner must recognize that the rook on e7 restrains a bishop on the opposite end of the seventh rank. Ka6 unpins it, and the capturing rook then steps off the bishop’s attack. This contrasts with the pinned-pawn rook win in the other packet entry.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxd5 — Xe trắng từ d7 bắt Xe ở d5. Tượng đen b7 không thể bắt lại vì sẽ để Xe e7 chiếu Vua a7. Nếu Vua đen sang a6 để giải ghim, Rd6 đưa Xe ra khỏi đường bắt của Tượng.
hintsVi: Xe e7 và Vua đen a7 nằm trên cùng một hàng.
Tượng b7 có thể rời hàng 7 để bắt Xe ở d5 không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Re7 pins Bb7 to Ka7. Removing Re7 makes Bxd5 legal and restores the starting balance after an equal rook exchange. White has no immediate countercapture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 29 legal roots compared. Rxb7+ Rxb7 loses the exchange, Rc7 allows Rdd8 and yields no material, and quiet moves allow Rxd7 Rxd7. No solver mate. Kh1 and Kh2 instead allow Black’s mating threat Rh5+ Kg1 Rh1#. Exact legal replay also ruled out a solver mate in one or forced mate in two.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 14 legal replies retain +500 cp immediately. Neither rook can be captured at the root. After Ka6, the played Rd6 takes the attacked rook to safety. Against Re8, Rxe8 Bxd5 is an equal rook trade after the gain, while the deep Rdd7 Rxe7 Rxe7 line also retains the extra rook.
reviewNotes.level: One direct rook capture in a materially contested ending, followed only by a simple retreat if Black unpins the bishop. No sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Bolanos–Nosach, 2nd 3-0 Thu 19th Feb 2026, checksummed TWIC archive. Complete replay reaches exact ply 58 after Black Rxd5. White Rxd5 Ka6 Rd6 was played.

reviews.reason: Black wins the opposing rook in one move through the rank pin, while a genuine advanced passed pawn keeps the position instructional.
reviews.distinctness: The black rook on c2 pins a bishop along a rank, allowing the other rook to take a rook. The closest rook pin on a bishop, Gyenes–Shirov Rxf4, instead uses a file pin to take a pawn while saving an attacked rook. Here the capturing rook can go back to the d-file to stop promotion.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxf3 — Xe Đen từ f8 bắt Xe f3. Xe c2 ghim Tượng g2 vào Vua h2, nên Trắng không thể đáp Bxf3. Trong ván đấu, sau d7 Rd3 d8=Q+, Xe Đen bắt Hậu mới phong bằng Rxd8.
hintsVi: Xe c2 và Vua h2 cùng đứng trên hàng nào?
Tượng g2 sẽ để hở đường chiếu nào nếu rời hàng 2 để bắt ở f3?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rc2 pins Bg2 to Kh2. Removing Rc2 in the counterfactual permits Bxf3, restoring the adjusted initial material balance and leaving Black no immediate retake at f3.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 25 legal roots checked and no mate in at most two. Rxg2+ Kxg2 Rxf3 Kxf3 relinquishes the exchange and reaches -170 cp relative to the start. The quiet Rd2 may win a pawn after several turns and preserves the same rank pin, but it does not provide a comparable immediate rook gain.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All five immediate replies are non-captures. Kh3 unpins the bishop, but Rf8 moves the attacked rook away and retains +500 in the targeted line. d7 Rd3 d8=Q+ Rxd8 neutralizes promotion. All four promotions on d8 can be captured by the rook. The optional deeper ...Rxg2 Kxg2 trade is unnecessary to retain the gain.
reviewNotes.level: One direct rook capture without a sacrifice. The advanced passer requires a straightforward rook move only after the gain.
reviewNotes.provenance: Pribelszky–Santiago Vilca, 2nd 3-0 Thu 26th Mar 2026, complete checksum-bound TWIC 1638. Exact ply 95 after d6. Rxf3 d7 Rd3 d8=Q+ Rxd8 was played.

reviews.reason: The queen can take the bishop because the only nominal rook recapture would expose the king.
reviews.distinctness: A bishop restrains a rook while the queen captures a bishop and then answers a knight fork by retreating to defend f4. This differs from the queen-pins-rook example where the bishop takes a pawn.
reviews.solutionVi: Qxe7 — Hậu từ e6 bắt Tượng e7. Tượng c4 ghim Xe f7 vào Vua g8, nên Đen không thể đáp …Rxe7. Nếu Đen chơi …Nfd5, Hậu có thể lùi về e5 để bảo vệ Tượng f4.
hintsVi: Xe f7 có vẻ bảo vệ Tượng e7.
Nếu Xe bắt lại trên e7, đường chéo c4–g8 sẽ mở ra thế nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bc4 pins Rf7 to Kg8. Without Bc4, ...Rxe7 takes the queen for a bishop and White has no immediate recapture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 62 legal roots considered. axb7 Qxb7 returns the pawn, Qxf7+ Rxf7 loses the queen, and Bg3 Bd8 preserves material without winning it.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 37 immediate replies preserve at least +230 cp from the starting position. Neither attacking queen nor pinning bishop is immediately offered. ...Nfd5 Qe5 moves the queen and guards f4 against the knight, while ...Bd5 Qe2 Bxc4 Qxc4 trades bishops evenly and preserves a minor piece less a pawn. The tested strongest continuations retain at least two pawns of net material.
reviewNotes.level: One capture wins the bishop. The two strongest replies are threats and exchanges after the material gain, with no necessary sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Sarana–Daneshvar, Titled Tue 9th Apr 2026. Exact ply 34 after ...Rf8; Qxe7 is played in the checksummed complete game.

reviews.reason: Rxe5 wins a pawn through the existing rank pin, with a simple rook retreat against the unpinning king move.
reviews.distinctness: White’s king can step to c4, simultaneously releasing the bishop’s attack on e5 and attacking the stationary rook on b3. The e5 rook withdraws to b5 and protects its teammate, unlike Rxf4, where the capture saves a rook already under attack.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxe5 — Xe đen từ c5 bắt tốt ở e5. Tượng trắng c3 không thể bắt lại vì sẽ để Xe b3 chiếu Vua d3. Sau Kc4, phương án phân tích Reb5 đưa Xe e5 về cột b để bảo vệ Xe b3.
hintsVi: Quan sát hàng 3 từ Xe đen b3 đến Vua trắng d3.
Nếu Tượng c3 rời hàng 3 để bắt ở e5, Vua trắng có bị chiếu không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: The b3 rook pins the bishop on c3 to the king on d3. Removing it makes Bxe5 legal and then Kxe5 leaves -70 cp from the start, with no immediate follow-up recapture. The pawn can be won safely only through the pin.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 24 legal roots compared. Rc6 Rc1 and g5 Kd4 retain a positional edge without a quick material gain. Rbxc3+ Rxc3 loses the exchange, and Rcxc3+ Rxc3 has the same problem. No mating root. Exact legal replay also ruled out a solver mate in one or forced mate in two.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 14 replies keep the pawn immediately, with no legal capture of either rook. Kc4 unpins the bishop and attacks b3, but the one-million-node check confirms Reb5 as a simple retreat and mutual protection. Rf2 f5 gxf5+ gxf5 exchanges pawns, then Kxd6 and Rxh6 leave the original +100 cp material margin intact. The game’s alternative Rxc3+ is an inferior exchange offer, not necessary for the direct gain.
reviewNotes.level: A single pawn capture with no offer. The strong unpinning move has a straightforward reply that solves both attacks at once.
reviewNotes.provenance: Cunha–Yaniv, Titled Tue 17th Mar 2026, checksummed TWIC archive. Full replay verifies ply 93 after Rc2. Rxe5 and Kc4 were played. Reb5 is analysis and remains separate from the actual Rxc3+ continuation.

reviews.reason: Nxg6 safely wins a pawn through the existing bishop pin. Nf4 preserves the gain against the best bishop defence.
reviews.distinctness: A knight takes a flank pawn while the bishop pins the defending f7 pawn to the king on g8. The defender can send its bishop to f6 and threaten to drive the knight away. The learner can see that the knight can return to its starting square while the pawn remains won.
reviews.solutionVi: Nxg6 — Mã trắng từ f4 bắt tốt ở g6. Tốt đen f7 không thể bắt lại vì sẽ để Tượng c4 chiếu Vua g8. Sau Bf6, trong phương án phân tích, Mã có thể trở về f4 bằng Nf4.
hintsVi: Nhìn đường chéo từ Tượng c4 đến Vua đen g8.
Tốt f7 có thể rời đường chéo để bắt Mã ở g6 không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bc4 pins f7 to Kg8. Removing Bc4 makes fxg6 legal and loses the knight for the pawn (-220 cp) with no immediate White recapture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 38 legal roots compared, with no mate in one or forced mate in two. Nd5 Bd6 e5 Bxe5 concedes a pawn and needs more forcing play. Bxf7+ Kxf7 and Rd8+ Bxd8 lose material.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 24 replies keep the pawn immediately and offer neither the knight nor bishop. The played Bf6 e5 can allow later recovery in strong lines, so supplement with Bf6 Nf4. Million-node reply searches after ...Bg5 Nd3 and ...c6 Rd6 retain +100 or more through ordinary exchanges. After Bg5 immediately, f4 also retains the gain in deeper evidence.
reviewNotes.level: One safe direct capture in a balanced position. The stronger defensive bishop move permits a simple knight withdrawal, with no preparation or sacrifice.
reviewNotes.provenance: Grot–Mitrabha, Titled Tue 10th Feb 2026, checksummed TWIC 1632. Exact ply 46 after Bc8. Nxg6 Bf6 was played. The actual game continued e5; Nf4 is analysis.

reviews.reason: Keep the pawn recapture that prevents the enemy advanced pawn from advancing to b2.
reviews.distinctness: A rook pins a bishop against the king while a pawn removes the opponent’s advanced b3-pawn. The king can break the pin, so the e-rook must continue defending b3 from the third rank.
reviews.solutionVi: cxb3 — Tốt trắng từ c2 bắt tốt ở b3. Xe e5 ghim Tượng d5 vào Vua c5, nên Đen không thể đáp Bxb3. Nếu Vua đen đi Kd6 để giải ghim, Trắng có thể đưa Xe về e3 để bảo vệ tốt b3.
hintsVi: Tốt đen ở b3 có thể tiến thêm đến đâu?
Quan sát đường ghim từ Xe e5 qua Tượng d5 đến Vua c5.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Removing Re5 permits ...Bxb3, cancelling the gain with no recapture. The real board forbids it.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 30 roots compared. Ke3 lets the pawn reach b2 and only wins it in an exchange of pawns. Rxd5+ Kxd5 cxb3 loses the exchange. No independent simpler material win.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 14 replies retain +100 initially and neither participant is offered. After the played ...Kd6, 29.Re3 protects the pawn and retains the gain in the stronger line. Played 29.Rfxf5 allowed ...Rxf5 Rxf5 Bxb3, so the copy explicitly gives Re3 as an option.
reviewNotes.level: Direct one-move gain with one obvious defensive rook retreat. The starting material balance is +70, and the advanced pawn supplies counterplay.
reviewNotes.provenance: Fernandez–Tang, Titled Tue 30 Dec 2025, complete checksummed TWIC 1626 game. Replay reaches ply 54 after ...cxb3 and includes the played 28.cxb3 Kd6.

reviews.reason: Nxe4 wins the central pawn because the bishop on g2 cannot capture along its diagonal without exposing the king. The actual reply Nd5 allows Black to take a second pawn, and the pin release moves do not recover the first.
reviews.distinctness: A stationary rook pins a bishop laterally, letting a knight take a pawn diagonally defended by that bishop. The opponent’s king can step out of the pin, but Black can move the knight with check or capture another pawn. In published 4928a7e02ac06872, Nxe4 instead exploits a bishop pin on a knight.
reviews.solutionVi: Nxe4 — Mã từ f2 bắt tốt ở e4. Xe c2 ghim Tượng g2 vào Vua h2, nên Trắng không thể đáp Bxe4. Trong ván đấu, Trắng đi Nd5 và Đen bắt thêm tốt bằng ...Rxc4.
hintsVi: Quan sát Xe c2, Tượng g2 và Vua h2 trên hàng hai.
Nếu Mã bắt tốt e4, Tượng g2 có thể bắt lại mà vẫn che được đường chiếu vào Vua không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Removing Rc2 makes Bxe4 legal and changes +100 cp to −220 cp, with no Black capture available. The stationary rook is what prevents the bishop recapture.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 19 roots compared. Ng4+ Kh3 can repeat through Nf2+ Kh2 and still relies on the same Nxe4 motif in its best line. Kg8 and Re2 permit White to move the king or bishop without a short gain. Rxc4 as a starting move loses to Nxc4. No forced-mate lead.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: None of the 12 first replies captures either Black participant, and all retain +100 cp. Strong h5 and Nd5 retain the pawn in supplemental 1M-node replays. The actual Nd5 Rxc4 Ne3 Ra4 keeps both new pawns. The king moves Kh1 and Kg1 permit Nxg3, while Kh3 Nf2+ lets Black retreat the knight with tempo. Each pin release was separately checked at 1M nodes.
reviewNotes.level: A. One direct, non-sacrificial knight capture from nearly balanced nominal material. No preparation required.
reviewNotes.provenance: Nguyen Ngoc Truong Son–Esipenko, Chess.com Open PlayIn1, 2026-03-16. Exact TWIC 1638 replay after 56.Kh2 at ply 111, with played 56...Nxe4 57.Nd5 Rxc4. Both GM in source headers and archive checksum verified.

reviews.reason: The direct gain tests which piece can take on c4. The pinned bishop cannot recapture the rook, but it still attacks c4 so the adjacent white king cannot take the pawn itself.
reviews.distinctness: Castro Castro–Gubajdullin Rxc4 also has a stationary rook pinning a bishop so a second rook can take c4. Here the white king is adjacent to the pawn, making the legality of the king capture the central choice. The distant defending rook and ensuing checks are a secondary issue.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxc4 — Xe từ g4 bắt tốt c4. Xe b5 ghim Tượng d5 vào Vua e5, nên Đen không thể bắt lại bằng Bxc4. Tượng d5 vẫn khống chế c4, vì vậy Vua Trắng không thể bắt tốt ở ô này.
hintsVi: Xe b5 ghim Tượng d5 vào Vua e5 theo hàng nào?
So sánh nước bắt tốt c4 bằng Xe với nước bắt bằng Vua. Tượng d5 vẫn khống chế ô nào?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rb5 pins Bd5 to Ke5. Removing Rb5 makes Bxc4 legal, giving -400 cp before the king takes back on c4 and still -70 cp after Kxc4. On the original board Kb4 cannot capture the pawn because Bd5 attacks c4 even under pin. Verified on the exact board and against FIDE Laws 3.1.3 and 3.9.1, https://handbook.fide.com/chapter/E012023.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 23 legal roots compared and no mate within three. Rxd5+ Kxd5 Rxc4 drops the exchange. Quiet a5, Ra5 and Rc5 can reach a gain over three turns, often by transposing to Rxc4 or by taking after Black voluntarily advances c3. They do not provide a simpler direct capture and do not undermine the contrast between rook and king capture on c4.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 13 immediate replies are non-captures, so neither rook is offered. Targeted Kd6 Rf4 and Kd6 Rb6+ lines keep the pawn without having to trade both rooks for a pawn ending. Rh7 Rc1 Rh4+ Ka5 also retains the gain and allows an equal rook trade later.
reviewNotes.level: Direct one-move non-sacrificial removal of the passed pawn. The legal rook-versus-king choice can be seen without a preparation sequence.
reviewNotes.provenance: Matviishen–Ostrovskiy, 35th Carlos Torre Memorial, 2025-12-16, checksum-bound complete TWIC 1624 game. Exact ply 150 after ...Ke5. Rxc4 was played.

reviews.reason: The bishop pin allows the pawn recapture and creates a direct threat to take on d6, leaving a passed pawn.
reviews.distinctness: An endgame pawn recapture exploits a bishop’s diagonal pin and threatens a second capture with check. Daurelle–De La Tullaye uses a rook file pin in the opening and tests a central pawn capture without a passed-pawn follow-up.
reviews.solutionVi: bxc5 — Tốt trắng từ b4 bắt tốt ở c5. Tượng f4 ghim tốt d6 vào Vua c7, nên Đen không thể đáp dxc5. Nếu Đen lui Tượng về e8, Trắng có thể bắt tiếp ở d6 và chiếu Vua.
hintsVi: Tốt d6 có đang che đường chiếu của Tượng f4 không?
Tốt b4 có thể bắt ở c5 mà không bị tốt d6 bắt lại không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Without Bf4 the reply ...dxc5 is legal and cancels the gain. On the actual board the d-pawn shields Kc7 along f4–e5–d6–c7.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 30 legal roots checked. After Rc1 Bd4+ Ke2 Kb6 the pin is released and bxc5+ dxc5 fails to keep the pawn. Bxd6+ Rxd6 loses material, and Ke2 allows ...cxb4.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 25 replies keep +100 or better immediately with no captures of either participant. ...Be8 and ...Bb2 can be met by cxd6+, while after ...Be5 Bxe5 dxe5 the initial gain survives the even bishop trade. The capture is also strong after ...Bf8.
reviewNotes.level: One direct pawn capture with a visible pin and no sacrifice. The possible second pawn illustrates the threat rather than a prerequisite for the initial gain.
reviewNotes.provenance: Yip–Kejna, Reykjavik Open, complete checksummed TWIC 1638 game. Exact ply 82 after ...bxc5, followed by played 42.bxc5 Bc3. ...Be8 is hypothetical.

reviews.reason: gxf4 wins an advanced pawn because the knight that defends it is pinned. The independent exchange route is longer and gives Black a drawn ending.
reviews.distinctness: The pinned knight is defended by a rook, so capturing the pinned piece first leads to several exchanges and loses the advantage. Capturing the pawn instead preserves the active pieces while stopping the pawn’s attack on g3.
reviews.solutionVi: gxf4 — Tốt trắng từ g3 bắt tốt ở f4. Mã đen d5 không thể bắt lại vì sẽ để Tượng c4 chiếu Vua e6.
hintsVi: Tốt đen f4 đang tấn công tốt trắng g3.
Nhìn đường chéo c4–d5–e6. Mã d5 có thể bắt ở f4 không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Bc4 pins Nd5 to Ke6, making Nxf4 illegal. Removing the bishop restores Nxf4 and removes the pawn gain. The only immediate Rxd7 is met by Kxd7, an equal rook trade.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 24 legal roots compared. No mate in one or forced mate in two. The forcing Bxd5+ Rxd5 Rxd5 Kxd5 gxf4 uses three solver turns and reaches a drawn pawn ending in 900k-node probes. Later Ke6 can recover f4. Rxd5 Rxd5 loses the exchange until further play. Other roots have no similarly simple material gain.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 16 legal replies keep +100 cp immediately and neither pawn nor pinner is offered. Against the strongest h4, deeper supplementary Bb3 and Rd4 lines retain the pawn through h3 counterplay. g3+ Kxg3 increases the gain.
reviewNotes.level: One direct pawn capture without preparation or sacrifice. The required material gain is visible and subsequent pawn pushes do not recover it.
reviewNotes.provenance: Omonov–Azali, 8th Golden Apricot 2025, checksummed TWIC 1618. Complete replay verifies exact ply 94 after exf4. gxf4 was played.

reviews.reason: Rxe6 uses the diagonal queen pin to win a bishop. Castling releases the pawn, but a simple rook retreat keeps the entire gain, with no offer required.
reviews.distinctness: The defender can castle out of the queen’s diagonal pin. The learner captures first and can then retract the rook before the newly unpinned pawn captures. This differs from the published Rxe5 against a pawn pinned by a bishop and from Rxb4, where a subsequent ordinary exchange deliberately releases the pin.
reviews.solutionVi: Rxe6 — Xe từ e1 bắt Tượng ở e6. Hậu h5 ghim tốt f7 vào Vua e8, nên Đen chưa thể đáp ...fxe6. Phương án phân tích. Nếu Đen nhập thành cánh Vua, Trắng có thể đi Re1 để giữ Xe và phần vật chất vừa thắng.
hintsVi: Hãy nhìn đường chéo h5–e8 trước khi xét nước ...fxe6.
Nếu Vua Đen rời e8 bằng cách nhập thành, Xe e6 có thể về đâu?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Without the h5 queen, fxe6 is legal and reduces the +330 cp bishop capture to −170 cp. The tempting Bxd5 then temporarily reaches +150 cp but both Qxd5 and exd5 bring it to −180 cp.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 43 roots compared. Bb5+ allows Kf8, and g3 or b4 allows castling before the capture. Bxd5 is met by Qxd5 and Qxf7+ by Bxf7. No simpler short gain or positive forced-mate lead.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 29 initial replies retain +330 cp and neither piece can be captured then. Best ...O-O releases the pin, and Re1 safely preserves the entire gain through Nb4 Bb3 and the d-pawn play. Separate 1M-node comparisons cover O-O Re1, Nb6, g6, Kf8 and Kd7. The actual Bxd5 after castling offers the rook, but the stronger Re1 line keeps it and is shown as an analysis branch.
reviewNotes.level: A. One direct capture from a material deficit. A straightforward rook retreat against castling keeps the advantage without a sacrifice or a preparation move.
reviewNotes.provenance: Alonso Moyano–Winkels, Titled Tue, 2026-05-05. Exact TWIC 1644 game replay after 11...Be7 at ply 22 and played 12.Rxe6. IM White in source. Game continued O-O Bxd5, with Re1 identified separately as analysis. Archive checksum retained.

reviews.reason: The long file pin makes the bishop capture safe, while the defender can still advance the pinned pawn along the file.
reviews.distinctness: The pinned b-pawn can make the legal b3 advance, which attacks Black’s other pawn after its king unpins. It cannot capture diagonally on a3. This is different from the previously published rook pin on a bishop or a pin released only by king movement.
reviews.solutionVi: Bxa3 — Tượng đen từ d6 bắt tốt ở a3. Tốt trắng b2 không thể bắt lại vì sẽ để Xe b8 chiếu Vua b1. Tốt b2 vẫn có thể tiến đến b3 trên cột b.
hintsVi: Quan sát cột b từ Xe đen b8 đến Vua trắng b1.
So sánh nước tốt bắt ở a3 với nước tốt tiến đến b3.

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Rb8 pins b2 to Kb1. Removing the rook permits bxa3 and loses the bishop for a pawn (-230 cp). Bxg4 is met by hxg4 and does not recover the loss.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 33 legal roots compared, including an exact negative mate-in-one and forced-mate-in-two check. Bxg4 hxg4 and Rxb2+ Kxb2 lose material, while quiet Be5, Rb6 and Bf4 retain strategic play but give no simpler immediate gain.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 27 legal replies retain +100 cp immediately. Neither bishop nor rook is offered. Strong Bc4 and Re2+ lines preserve the pawn. Supplemental 900k checks show b3 Bd6 or b3 Bc5 preserves the gain through ordinary exchanges, including Bc5 Ka2 axb3+ Bxb3.
reviewNotes.level: One direct pawn capture, no preparation or sacrifice. The solution distinguishes a pinned pawn’s legal straight advance from its illegal diagonal recapture.
reviewNotes.provenance: Florescu–Kim, 1st 3-0 Thu 26th Feb 2026, checksummed TWIC 1634. Exact ply 71 after Bd5. Bxa3 was played; b3 is a legal alternative reply.

reviews.reason: An immediate pawn capture exploits the rook interposition and opens a safe route for the black king to contain the other pawn.
reviews.distinctness: In a queen-versus-two-rooks endgame a rook just interposed on a long diagonal. Black must use the pin before White can move the king out of the diagonal and play Rxf5+.
reviews.solutionVi: exf5 — Tốt đen từ e6 bắt tốt ở f5. Hậu c7 ghim Xe e5 vào Vua h2, nên Trắng không thể bắt lại bằng Rxf5+. Trong ván đấu, sau Kg1, Đen đưa Vua đến g6 để chặn tốt g5.
hintsVi: Xe e5 vừa che đường chiếu của Hậu c7. Đường chéo ấy kết thúc ở đâu?
Tốt e6 có thể bắt ở f5 trước khi Vua trắng rời đường ghim không?

reviewNotes.motifNecessity: Removing Qc7 makes Rxf5+ legal, immediately erasing the gain. White cannot execute it from e5 while Kh2 remains on the diagonal.
reviewNotes.simplerAlternatives: All 26 legal roots checked. Qxe5+ Rxe5 loses the queen for a rook. The slower ...b4 Kh1 or ...a4 Kg2 allows Rxf5+ and misses the direct f5 gain. A later pawn capture in a long ...b4 continuation is separate from the immediate objective.
reviewNotes.defencesAndRecovery: All 16 replies preserve at least +100 initially with no legal capture of either participant. ...Kg6 contains the g5-pawn after either Kg2 or Kg3; the played Kg1 Kg6 also keeps the pawn. An immediate g6+ is met by ...hxg6.
reviewNotes.level: One direct capture without a material offer. Equal starting material, with two advanced White pawns and active rooks making the timing meaningful.
reviewNotes.provenance: Cervello Tost–Barbero Senidic, TCh-CAT GpB Final 2026, complete checksummed TWIC 1637. Exact ply 97 after Re5 and played 49...exf5 50.Kg1 Kg6.

reviews.reason: Rxg5 wins a pawn through the f-file pin and leaves both rooks available to control the advanced a-pawn.
reviews.distinctness: The capturing rook can cross from g5 to a5 to attack a passer near promotion, while the stationary rook can block its promotion square. This active defence differs from the f-file pawn pin in Rxg4 and the examples where a simple king unpin is the main counterplay.
